summary.en: TuringSpace is a synthetic web environment of 125 interactive CAPTCHAs testing five spatial abilities via clicks and drags. Humans solve 94.1%, GPT-6 Astra fails 25.9%, Kimi K3 fails 68.0%; fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B raises success from 1.6% to 33.1% and gains 9.9 points on VSI-Bench.
summary.zh: TuringSpace 构建了包含 125 个交互式 CAPTCHA 的合成网页环境，覆盖五项空间能力，需通过鼠标点击和拖拽求解；人类成功率为 94.1%，最佳模型 GPT-6 Astra 失败 25.9%，开源模型 Kimi K3 失败 68.0%，在 Qwen3.5-9B 上微调后成功率从 1.6% 升至 33.1%，并在 VSI-Bench 上提升 9.9 分。

summary.en: Antom 3-in-1 Transformer is a ~7B-parameter payment foundation model fusing sequence, tabular, and graph representations; pretraining lifts cross-business transfer by 34.5% over scratch and cuts online loss rate 37.88% versus XGB-Online.
summary.zh: Antom 3-in-1 Transformer 是约 7B 参数的支付基础模型，融合序列、表格与图表示做支付风险检测，预训练使跨业务迁移目标指标较同架构从零训练提升 34.5%，仅用 25% 标签即在 AP 与 Recall@0.5% 上超过全标签基线，线上四个月实验相对 XGB-Online 降低整体损失率 37.88%。

summary.en: DiLE encodes task information into a compact latent space via learnable queries, combining shared-private expert adaptation and on-policy hard-negative distillation to preserve discriminative evidence, achieving SOTA on MMEB-v2, UVRB, and MRMR.
summary.zh: DiLE 通过少量可学习 query 在紧凑隐空间编码任务信息，结合共享-私有专家适配与 on-policy 难负例蒸馏，使多模态嵌入保留区分性证据，在 MMEB-v2、UVRB、MRMR 上取得 SOTA。

orgs.name: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

summary.en: WeightCode uses a frozen language model to write executable weight programs that install new capabilities into trained networks without gradient training, lifting unseen command compositions from 0% to 99.8% and a new action to 98.4%, and gaining 8.84-17.62 points on ImageNet over eight fine-tuning methods.
summary.zh: WeightCode 用冻结语言模型编写可执行权重程序，无需梯度训练即可向已训练网络装入新能力：新指令组合精确匹配从 0% 升至 99.8%，新动作成功率达 98.4%；ImageNet 上四个程序净提升 8.84–17.62 点，优于八种微调方法。

summary.en: LingSante MedGuard unifies a medical guardrail teacher with six medical capability experts via supervised fine-tuning and multi-teacher on-policy distillation, plus the 11-subset MedGuardBench, reaching mean F1 of 82.3%/82.4%/87.4% at 4B/9B/27B scales.
summary.zh: LingSante MedGuard 将医疗护栏教师模型与六个医疗能力专家整合为统一护栏，经离线监督微调与多教师在线策略蒸馏训练，并构建含 11 个风险子集的 MedGuardBench；在 4B、9B、27B 规模下平均 F1 分别达 82.3%、82.4%、87.4%。

summary.en: Duopra learns task execution alongside full-duplex conversational control, treating the backend as a tool; three-stage training lifts Pass@1 from 4.7% to 44.7% and direct tool calling to 47.7%.
summary.zh: Duopra 将任务执行与全双工对话控制统一训练，把后端当作工具接受自包含自然语言请求，经协议 SFT、奖励及时完整执行的全双工 RL 和仅 projector 修复三阶段训练；同一后端下 Pass@1 从 4.7% 升至 44.7%，直接调用工具达 47.7%。

orgs.name: Huazhong University of Science and Technology

summary.en: Fast-JEPA restructures latent world model prediction to score complete action candidates directly instead of recursive rollout, reaching 96.50% average success on PushT, Reacher, Cube and TwoRoom with 2.41x faster planning than INTACT.
summary.zh: Fast-JEPA 重构潜在世界模型的预测计算，用目标导向计划引导搜索并直接预测完整动作候选的结果，避免递归 rollout；在 PushT、Reacher、Cube、TwoRoom 上平均成功率达 96.50%，规划速度比 INTACT 快 2.41 倍。

orgs.name: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence

summary.en: Lifts the first frame into 3D points, simulates their response to robot actions with a learned point dynamics model, then renders pixel-aligned videos for any video model, cutting object motion error by 8.6%/6.2% on DROID and 8.1% on a real bimanual robot.
summary.zh: 将首帧提升为3D点，用学习到的点动力学模型模拟机器人动作下点的响应，再渲染成像素对齐视频供视频模型读取；在DROID上搭配两种渲染器使物体运动误差降低8.6%和6.2%，真实双臂机器人上降低8.1%。

summary.en: AFFECT injects temporally correlated noise into policy actions and trains world models to mirror real video responses to action perturbations, raising DROID policy-success correlation from 0.47 to 0.79 and planning success by up to 8.3%.
summary.zh: AFFECT 通过在策略动作上注入时间相关噪声，训练世界模型生成的视频像真实视频一样响应动作扰动；在 DROID 上世界模型与真机策略成功率相关系数从 0.47 升至 0.79，FVD 最多降 23%，规划成功率最多提升 8.3%。

summary.en: AltRA-Test is a bootstrap-based statistical test that replaces one of k human annotations per item with an LLM annotation to compare inter-annotator agreement between all-human and mixed panels, requiring no shared annotators and often only ~100 items.
summary.zh: AltRA-Test 是一种无需所有条目由同一批标注者标注的统计检验，通过自助重采样条目、抽取 k 个人工标注并替换其中一条为 LLM 标注，构造配对的纯人工与混合人机评审组，以组内一致性（IAA）非劣于纯人工组作为替换成立的判据；在 18 个 LLM、5 种提示技术、20 个文本/图像/音频/视频数据集上验证，约 100 条数据常已足够，模拟中比现有基线做出更多正确的替换决策，真实数据约半数设置通过。

summary.en: HiUni reuses one language-aligned ViT and dense Transformer backbone for both visual understanding and generation, adding a Pixel Diffusion Head and lightweight HiGate at the output; it matches the pretrained VLM's average understanding score while remaining competitive on generation and editing.
summary.zh: HiUni 复用同一个与语言对齐的 ViT 和稠密 Transformer 骨干同时做视觉理解与生成，只在输出端加 Pixel Diffusion Head 直接优化像素空间，并用轻量 HiGate 补充细粒度空间细节；理解均分与预训练 VLM 接近，生成和编辑也具竞争力。

summary.en: LightningMoBA co-designs dynamic routing, KV-centric ownership and runtime pipelining for Mixture of Block Attention, achieving 1.20-1.60x faster end-to-end generation at Top-16 retention while raising mean RULER score from 74.42 to 75.28.
summary.zh: LightningMoBA 通过动态路由、以 KV 为中心的调度和运行时流水线协同优化 MoBA 长上下文注意力，在五个 checkpoint 上 Top-16 保留率下，端到端生成提速 1.20–1.60×，RULER 均分由 74.42 升至 75.28。

summary.en: Beam, a 501.3B-parameter sparse MoE with 23.4B active parameters, targets coding, reasoning and agentic workloads: 23.8T-token pretraining, 1M context via two-stage midtraining, and large-scale asynchronous RL on 10.5K GB300 GPUs.
summary.zh: Beam 是总参 501.3B、激活 23.4B 的稀疏 MoE 模型，面向编码、推理与智能体任务，预训练用 23.8T token，经两阶段 midtraining 获 1M 上下文，并在 10.5K GB300 GPU 上完成超 1 亿 rollout 的大规模异步 RL，推理性价比同类模型高 3-4 倍。

orgs.name: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)

summary.en: EgoCaptioner pairs video-level overviews with timestamped step captions, built via coarse-to-fine annotation over 50K examples from eight egocentric sources and refined with GRPO rewards for factuality and temporal alignment, leading open-source models on five egocentric benchmarks.
summary.zh: EgoCaptioner 用视频级概览加带时间戳的分步描述，通过粗到细标注流程从八个第一视角视频源生成5万训练样本，并用GRPO结合事实与时间对齐奖励精炼字幕，在五个第一视角基准上取得开源模型领先水平，PhysicsCapBench超过Gemini 3.1 Pro。

summary.en: ViDecide trains video diffusion models as decision-centric state-transition predictors with stopping decisions and Corrective Fine-tuning, reaching 83.8% strict success versus 23.3% for fine-tuning and 67.8% for the best prior method.
summary.zh: ViDecide 将视频扩散模型的训练从固定长度片段改为以决策为中心的状态转移预测与终止判断，并用 Corrective Fine-tuning 将失败决策的噪声映射到自身成功续写，在抽象游戏、规划任务和新机器人规划基准上严格成功率平均 83.8%，高于标准微调的 23.3% 和最强先前方法的 67.8%。

summary.en: A benchmark of LLM-driven weight-space programming lets five LLMs edit CNNs and ViTs on four datasets, scoring 2,600+ edits. Edit-Ready Training rehearses closed-form weight edits, raising edit success, notably for GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5.
summary.zh: 构建LLM驱动权重空间编程基准，让五个LLM在Waterbirds、CIFAR-100、PACS和Entity-30上编辑卷积网络与视觉Transformer，完成重标注和纠错任务，记录超2600次编辑并评估成功率、副作用与精度损失；提出Edit-Ready Training (ERT)通过预演LLM的直接闭式权重编辑来训练网络，在标准网络难以编辑处显著提升成功率，并在所有基线中为GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5.5取得最高平均分。

summary.en: WeMM-Video is a bilingual omni-modal video model family (2B–35B-A3B) with thinking and non-thinking modes, trained on ~1.2T tokens; the 35B-A3B flagship outperforms Qwen3.5-Omni-Flash and Seed2.0-Mini-0428 on omni-modal video benchmarks.
summary.zh: WeMM-Video 是覆盖 2B/4B/9B/35B-A3B 的中英双语全模态基础模型，统一文本、图像、音频、视频并支持非思考与思考双模式，用约 1.2 万亿 token 渐进预训练与多教师 OPD、MrDPO、专家 RL 训练，旗舰 35B-A3B 在全模态视频评测中超越 Qwen3.5-Omni-Flash 与 Seed2.0-Mini-0428。

summary.en: ZeroVLN couples a frozen-ish VLM brain with an action expert via semantic tool calls, jointly trained by closed-loop RL; it beats SFT-based hierarchical VLN methods on VLN-CE while barely altering the brain's weights.
summary.zh: ZeroVLN 采用慢-快导航框架，VLM 大脑不做导航域 SFT，改以语义工具调用接口用自然语言向动作专家下达移动指令，再通过闭环强化学习联合优化两者；在 VLN-CE 基准上显著优于代表性 SFT 分层方法，且大脑权重变化极小、通用能力基本保留。

orgs.name: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

summary.en: Mind2Act World is a 30-task, 180-configuration diagnostic manipulation benchmark with Mind, Act, and Mind2Act views; the best agent scores 52.7% and 39.0% but only 12.0% on Mind2Act.
summary.zh: Mind2Act World 构建 30 个仿真操作任务、180 种配置的诊断基准，分 Mind、Act、Mind2Act 三视角评测多模态智能体、VLA 与 WAM；最强智能体在 Mind 与 Act 上分别成功 52.7% 和 39.0%，Mind2Act 仅 12.0%。

summary.en: Closed-form zero-gradient circuit-grafting compiles exact multi-digit arithmetic and Boolean/majority circuits into pretrained LM weights without training data or runtime hooks; Granite 4.2 3B and Qwen 3.5 4B reach 99.17%/100.00% ALU-prefix accuracy versus 42.2%/61.7% for 12.8K-sample LoRA.
summary.zh: 闭式零梯度电路嫁接原语将精确多位数算术与布尔/多数/奇偶电路直接编译进预训练权重，无需训练样本或运行时钩子；IBM Granite 4.2 3B 与 Qwen 3.5 4B 在 6 位数算术上达 99.17%/100.00% ALU 前缀准确率，远超 12.8K 样本 LoRA 的 42.2%/61.7%。

summary.en: Skill-FT uses natural-language skills to shape teacher rollouts, with AutoMaster autonomously designing interventions; it improves 4B and 9B students by 1.42–8.99 points over vanilla SFT on Terminal, Search, and software engineering tasks.
summary.zh: Skill-FT 利用自然语言技能干预教师 rollout 以抑制不良行为并激发有效行为，AutoMaster 让 LLM agent 自动设计这些干预；在 Terminal、Search 和软件工程任务上，4B 和 9B 学生模型相比 Vanilla SFT 平均性能提升 1.42–8.99 个百分点。

summary.en: Direct3D-V3 is a latent-free diffusion transformer that models raw SDF voxel grids directly, using implicit manifold regularization and Marching Cubes normal supervision to generate meshes with richer local detail.
summary.zh: Direct3D-V3 提出无 latent 的扩散 Transformer 框架，直接在原生 SDF 体素域训练与采样，引入隐式流形正则抑制非水密表面，并用 Marching Cubes 转网格施加渲染法向监督，生成网格局部细节更丰富。

summary.en: Plan4d stitches Depth Anything 3 with LongCat-Video plus a DPT head for scene flow, generating RGB videos and dense 4D geometry from scene context and text actions, achieving state-of-the-art generative 4D modeling.
summary.zh: plan4d 将 Depth Anything 3 与 LongCat-Video 缝合，并加 DPT 头预测场景流，从场景上下文和文本动作生成 RGB 视频及稠密 4D 几何，在合成与真实数据上取得生成式 4D 建模最优性能。

summary.en: Multimodal Concept Lens (MC-Lens), a multimodal Jacobian lens, maps VLM intermediate states into a shared semantic space and uses concept interventions to show accessed concepts feed downstream reasoning; selective access develops later than concept accessibility across VLM families.
summary.zh: Multimodal Concept Lens (MC-Lens) 用多模态 Jacobian lens 把 VLM 中间状态映射到解码器词表构成的共享语义空间，并通过概念干预验证概念信息参与下游推理；实验发现选择性访问比概念可读性更晚发展，且跨模型家族存在共享模式。

orgs.name: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)
Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

summary.en: Controlled experiments and blinded human evaluation probe proxy granularity, physics simulation, and prompting in Code2Video, yielding Coda-DaVinci, a task-adaptive multi-agent framework with leading instruction following on VTR and scene consistency on R2M.
summary.zh: 通过受控实验与盲测人类评估，系统考察 Code2Video 中代理粒度、物理模拟与提示词的影响，并据此构建任务自适应多智能体框架 Coda-DaVinci，在 VTR 与 R2M 上取得领先的指令遵循和场景一致性。

summary.en: Depth Pro 2 trains one scalable network on images and video to predict native-resolution depth that is metrically accurate, sharp, and temporally consistent, outperforming prior work and redefining the Pareto frontier.
summary.zh: Depth Pro 2 用单一可扩展网络统一处理图像与视频，以原生分辨率预测稠密深度，同时兼顾度量精度、边界锐利度与时序一致性，在四项指标上超越先前方法并重划 Pareto 前沿。

orgs.name: Bosch Research North America & Bosch Center for Artificial Intelligence (BCAI)

summary.en: AgentRoboCritic critiques each robot action against a stated local intent, enabling action-level analysis of frontier agents across 12 manipulation benchmarks; a fine-tuned open-source critic, Muse-Glimmer-30B, raises failure-mode accuracy from 32.58% to 74.24%.
summary.zh: AgentRoboCritic 是一个以意图为依据的动作级评估框架：策略智能体在每步动作旁给出局部意图，评判器据此判断动作结果与失败模式，并在 12 个操作基准上分析前沿多模态智能体直接控制机器人的表现；微调后的开源评判器 Muse-Glimmer-30B 失败模式准确率从 32.58% 升至 74.24%。

summary.en: O²LaF repurposes one pretrained video DiT as both inverse and forward dynamics, trained end-to-end through a compact bottleneck, achieving state-of-the-art few-shot action probing and stronger zero-shot action transfer in navigation and manipulation.
summary.zh: O²LaF 将同一个预训练视频 DiT 复用作逆动力学与正动力学两个模型，通过控制信息通路与紧凑瓶颈端到端训练，在导航和机器人操作中刷新 few-shot 动作探测最优结果，并实现更强的零样本动作迁移。

summary.en: Fixed steering vectors added to frozen base-model block outputs, 65x smaller than RL-tuned LoRA, recover 90.0-96.3% of reward gains on six RL-tuned image models and 89.8%/111.9% on two video models.
summary.zh: 用固定的一组 steering vectors 加到冻结基座模型 block 输出上，以 SD3.5-M 上 0.29M 参数（比 RL-tuned LoRA 少 65 倍）复现六个图像 RL 模型 90.0–96.3% 的奖励增益，两个视频模型达 89.8% 和 111.9%。

summary.en: Posterior Matching Distillation combines mode-covering posterior sampling with any-step generation by matching exponentially tilted student sample means, achieving the best 4-step FID on SDXL and FLUX.2 [klein] 4B.
summary.zh: PMD 将模式覆盖的后验采样与任意步数生成结合，通过匹配指数重加权学生样本均值来学习教师后验，在 SDXL 和 FLUX.2 [klein] 4B 上取得 4 步方法中最佳 FID。

summary.en: Future-OPSD turns unlabeled past-future video pairs into on-policy self-distillation signals and uses a contrastive privilege advantage to focus on decision-relevant future content, improving base models by up to 14.2 and 15.9 points on open-ended prediction and closed-ended planning.
summary.zh: Future-OPSD 用 on-policy 自蒸馏把无标注的过去-未来视频对转成自监督信号，并用对比式特权优势聚焦关键未来信息，在开放式预测和封闭式规划上分别比基座模型最高提升 14.2 和 15.9 分。

orgs.name: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)

summary.en: CmHC geometrically contracts the Birkhoff polytope inward to mix residual streams, mitigating under- and over-mixing; it stabilizes pretraining of dense and MoE models and cuts hyper-connection latency by up to 44.8% on Ascend NPUs.
summary.zh: cmHC 通过将 Birkhoff 多面体几何收缩到内部来混合残差流，缓解 under-mixing 与 over-mixing 的权衡，在稠密和 MoE 模型预训练中稳定梯度传播，并在 Ascend NPU 上将超连接执行延迟降低最多 44.8%。

summary.en: StylePrism defines 28 stylistic aspects in seven categories, and SP-Refine extracts an explicit style profile at inference, then drafts from user samples and revises twice against it. On LongLaMP with three LLMs it beats the retrieval-augmented baseline in 25 of 27 ROUGE/METEOR comparisons, averaging 10.2% and up to 35.8% gains.
summary.zh: StylePrism 将用户写作风格归纳为 7 类 28 个方面的显式画像，SP-Refine 在推理时先生成该画像，再基于用户样本起草并对照画像和风格分数修订两次；在 LongLaMP 三个长文任务、三个 LLM 上，27 项 ROUGE/METEOR 对比中 25 项优于检索增强基线，平均提升 10.2%，最高 35.8%。

orgs.name: The Chinese University of Hong Kong (Shenzhen)

summary.en: Prune to Expand (P2E), a text-only method that prunes redundant sentences from dense-caption supervision under a per-example deletion bound, improves prompt-enhancer alignment with human preferences and image quality over dense-caption SFT.
summary.zh: Prune to Expand (P2E) 是一种纯文本方法，通过按样本删除上限选择性移除密集描述中的冗余句子来精炼监督信号，在相同训练配置下相比常规密集描述 SFT 提升了生成图像与人类偏好的一致性和视觉质量。

summary.en: SAVIOR curates sample-efficient data for high-impact financial-OCR failures and fine-tunes Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct, reaching 0.93 word recall and 0.89 document-QA F1, beating GPT-4o, Mistral-OCR, PaddleOCR-VL and DeepSeek-OCR; PaIRS measures layout fidelity.
summary.zh: SAVIOR 针对金融 OCR 中的旋转文本、logo 内嵌名称、细小条款与退化扫描等高频失败模式做样本高效数据筛选，并用 Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct 微调；配套的 PaIRS 指标衡量布局保真度，词召回达 0.93，文档问答 F1 为 0.89，超过 GPT-4o、Mistral-OCR、PaddleOCR-VL 和 DeepSeek-OCR。

summary.en: CSPD freezes the pre-RL backbone, distills each RL expert into an independent soft prompt, and composes experts by concatenating prompts without joint training, matching MOPD (67.83 vs. 67.79) and reaching 2.40x LoRA throughput.
summary.zh: CSPD 冻结 RL 前的基座模型，将每个 RL 专家独立蒸馏为一个 soft prompt，再通过拼接 prompt 组合专家而无需联合训练；单个 prompt 在 23 个数学、代码、agent 设置中的 22 个恢复至少 90% 的教师提升，完整组合在多专家设置下达到 67.83，与 MOPD 的 67.79 持平，吞吐量为未适配基座的 1.5% 以内、是 rank-4 LoRA 的 2.40 倍。

summary.en: TIPO, a training-free generate-evaluate-judge pipeline, tracks object assemblies and disassemblies using mask proposals, overlap scoring, and MLLM verification; on the new VISTA benchmark it achieves state-of-the-art tracking and state-graph accuracy while running 6–15× faster.
summary.zh: TIPO 提出无需训练、基于生成-评估-判别流程的变换跟踪框架，通过 mask 提案与重叠打分并用 MLLM 判定部件拆分与合并；在新建 VISTA（50 段视频、256 个变换事件、超 2.6 万帧）上取得最优跟踪与状态图精度，速度比此前方法快 6–15 倍。

summary.en: Doppeldwarf-306 benchmarks near-identical instance retrieval with 1,691 photos of 306 bronze dwarf statues; frozen DINOv2 nearest-neighbor reaches 93.1% leave-one-out accuracy, and using location as a weight lifts it to 98.7%.
summary.zh: Doppeldwarf-306 收录 306 尊波兰弗罗茨瓦夫铜侏儒雕像的 1,691 张照片，构成近同款实例检索基准；冻结 DINOv2 特征最近邻在留一查询上达 93.1%，13 个骨干中最佳 94.7%；定位信息作权重时 DINOv2 从 93.4% 升至 98.7%。

summary.en: Typhoon OCR 2 unifies prompt-driven extraction and structured full-page parsing in Thai, English, and Chinese via a 2B/0.8B model SFT-tuned and GRPO-trained; it scores 80.7 on Thai MDPBench and 59.91 on ThaiOCRBench, cutting repetition loops from 3.2% to 0.7%.
summary.zh: Typhoon OCR 2 用单一模型同时支持提示驱动抽取与泰文、英文、中文结构化整页解析，2B 和 0.8B 模型由开放文档解析器经监督微调与 GRPO 得到；2B 在 Thai MDPBench 得 80.7（Typhoon OCR 1.5 为 68.9），ThaiOCRBench 得 59.91（对比 40.45），英文与中英基准基本持平，GRPO 将 2B 的重复循环页面比例从 3.2% 降至 0.7%。

summary.en: Extending metric-update revocation within follow-the-regularized-leader and a mixture of base learners, the algorithm achieves minimax-optimal small-loss regret O(1+sqrt(Delta_T^*)) on l_p balls without knowing Delta_T^*, yielding Theta(sqrt(d)/kappa^2) contextual-search error and resolving an open question.
summary.zh: 基于follow-the-regularized-leader框架与多基学习器混合、扩展Gupta等(2026)的度量更新撤销机制，在只需每轮一个次梯度、无需知道Δ_T^⋆的条件下取得小损失遗憾O(1+√Δ_T^⋆)，在ℓ_p球上具minimax最优性；用于上下文搜索时达到Θ(√d/κ²)期望累积绝对误差，解决Liu等(2021)的开放问题。

orgs.name: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications

summary.en: PromptTTSD builds a scalable audiobook-based pipeline with improved two-stage alignment and LLM-extracted style descriptions to release PromptDialog (8,383h Chinese, 120h English); prompt-aware fine-tuning enables zero-shot voice cloning and natural-language style control with better multi-turn contextual appropriateness.
summary.zh: PromptTTSD 构建多旁白有声书语音提取流水线，结合改进的两阶段对齐算法与 LLM 风格描述抽取，发布含 8,383 小时中文、120 小时英文对话语音及开放风格描述的 PromptDialog；其提示感知微调支持零样本音色克隆与自然语言风格控制，多轮语境适切性显著提升。

summary.en: LS-MBPO performs residual RL on pretrained VLAs with a lightweight latent world model, using Hierarchical Forcing and Latent Subchunk Rollouts to cut compounding errors and bridge latent imagination with action execution.
summary.zh: LS-MBPO 用轻量潜在世界模型对预训练 VLA 做残差强化学习，结合 Hierarchical Forcing 与 Latent Subchunk Rollouts 缓解递归预测误差并衔接潜在想象与动作执行，在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 和真实 ALOHA 机器人上任务表现与训练效率优于现有方法。

summary.en: Tencent Hunyuan's Hy-MT3 multilingual translation family (1.8B/7B/30B-A3B MoE) cuts mistranslations 43%, omissions/additions 74% and instruction errors 40%, expands coverage from 38 to 102 languages; the 3B-activated 30B-A3B beats Qwen3.8-Max, Kimi-K3.1-Pro and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash in non-thinking mode, and releases the TransRubric evaluation suite.
summary.zh: 腾讯混元发布 Hy-MT3 多语言翻译模型族（1.8B/7B/30B-A3B MoE），真实场景数据上误译降 43%、漏译增译降 74%、指令遵循错误降 40%，语种从 38 扩至 102；30B-A3B 仅激活 3B 参数，非思考模式下综合性能超过 Qwen3.8-Max、Kimi-K3.1-Pro、DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash，并开源基于评分量表的评测套件 TransRubric。

orgs.name: Huazhong University of Science and Technology

summary.en: Embodied-Harness uses an Actor–Reflector dual-agent framework to recursively refine the execution harness without parameter updates, combining hierarchical memory and evidence-based failure reflection; it achieves 82.4%, 76.7%, and 94.4% success on RoboTwin 2.0, RoboSPA, and RMBench, and 96.7% real-world average.
summary.zh: Embodied-Harness 用 Actor–Reflector 双智能体在不更新模型参数的情况下递归精炼执行框架，并通过分层记忆和基于证据的失败归因进行经验反思，在 RoboTwin 2.0、RoboSPA、RMBench 上分别达到 82.4%、76.7%、94.4% 的成功率，真实世界三项任务平均成功率达 96.7%。

summary.en: Search-RSI recursively expands the searchable world along a multimodal agent's capability frontier, growing tasks with their evidence and routing probe-disagreement cases to RL; it beats static task growth by 9.8 and 9.5 points on nine benchmarks at 9B and 27B.
summary.zh: Search-RSI 让多模态搜索智能体沿能力边界递归扩展搜索世界：每轮按跳数、关系稀有度和干扰密度诊断半掌握区域，并同步生成任务与证据，对策略探测有分歧的样本做强化学习、超出能力的转为提示示范；在九个多模态搜索基准上，9B 和 27B 模型平均准确率分别较基线提升 9.8 和 9.5 点，算力为静态增长的 1.27 倍。

summary.en: A renormalized entropy from parameter symmetries predicts equilibrium preference for singular, low-rank functions and inactive neurons, yielding neural 'heat death'; interpreted via the neural tangent kernel as slow-variation simplicity bias.
summary.zh: 通过在高斯正则化 Langevin 动力学的零正则化极限下计算函数空间平衡分布，推导出源自参数对称性的重整化熵；对线性网络得到偏好奇异、低秩函数的显式熵项，对齐次激活网络发现偏好失活神经元的熵项，可能导致输出趋于零的 neural heat death，并用 neural tangent kernel 解释为慢变函数的 simplicity bias。

summary.en: DICE pre-samples and synchronizes verification randomness across drafting and verification, combining known draws with drafter predictions to allocate computation to likely-used continuations and extend to asynchronous prefetching; without extra training or changing the target sampling distribution, it achieves state-of-the-art decoding throughput with up to 24.6pp speedup over strong baselines.
summary.zh: DICE 通过在起草与验证之间预采样并同步随机数，将已知采样随机性与现有 drafter 预测结合，把计算分配给本次采样更可能用到的续写，并扩展到异步预取；无需额外训练或改变目标采样分布，吞吐量在多种设置下达到 SOTA，相较强基线最高提升 24.6pp。

orgs.name: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

summary.en: StereoVLM is a geometry-aware binocular VLM trained hierarchically from cross-view correspondence and disparity to metric depth and spatial reasoning, reaching 95.17% δ1 depth accuracy and 66.98 object-level score on Stereo3D-Bench, with 3.54-point average gains on five spatial benchmarks and +4.3 points RoboCasa manipulation success.
summary.zh: StereoVLM 是首个具备几何感知的双目 VLM，按跨视角对应、视差估计、标定条件度量深度、语义空间推理分层学习，在 Stereo3D-Bench 上 depth 准确率 δ1 达 95.17%、物体级均分 66.98，并在五个空间基准上平均提升 3.54 分、RoboCasa 操作成功率提升 4.3 个百分点。

summary.en: BioEmu2 is a generative model unifying structure prediction, equilibrium sampling, and time evolution, sampling orders of magnitude faster than MD with free-energy errors near 1 kcal/mol and folding accuracy comparable to top open-weight models.
summary.zh: BioEmu2 是一个生成式模型，将静态结构预测、平衡采样与时间演化统一到同一框架，速度比分子动力学（MD）快数个数量级；自由能误差约为 1 kcal/mol，可达到 MD 参考水平；结构预测精度与顶级开源折叠模型相当；支持兆道尔顿级复合物与蛋白、核酸、配体和离子的多组分体系。

summary.en: Model Carving learns scalar gates to prune Transformer sublayers during pretraining, jointly learning weights and topology; carved models beat dense models trained with up to 1.7x more compute, cutting FLOPs up to 34% and decoding 1.6x faster.
summary.zh: Model Carving 用可学习标量门在预训练中剪除 Transformer 子层，从而在单次训练里同时学权重与架构；从 140M 到 2.7B 参数预训练，同等算力下验证损失低于最多多用 1.7 倍算力的稠密模型，每 token FLOPs 最多降 34%，解码快 1.6 倍。

summary.en: NoPeBench benchmark reveals object penetration in interactive video world models; NoPeWorld trains a small head on frozen DiT hidden states to filter unsafe actions, cutting violation rates from 74% to 16% across six models.
summary.zh: 针对交互式视频世界模型中的物体穿透问题，构建 NoPeBench 基准并发现冻结 DiT 的隐状态已能预测碰撞，据此训练轻量预测头筛除不安全动作并替换为安全动作，在六个世界模型上将物理违规率从 74% 降至 16%。

summary.en: Task2Hand, a skill turning manipulation briefs into parameterized dexterous hands validated by cost-ordered contact, dynamics and learning gates, produced SAGE Hand, reaching 45.6% and 70.8% success versus LEAP's 37.3% and 51.6%.
summary.zh: Task2Hand 技能将功能操作需求转为参数化灵巧手模型，按成本排序依次通过接触、动力学与学习闸门生成 SAGE Hand（四指 16 驱动自由度），在六棱柱与双色圆柱任务上成功率 45.6%/70.8%，超过 LEAP 的 37.3%/51.6%。

orgs.name: University of Science and Technology of China

summary.en: MemOnce caches only compact final-layer hidden states and decodes them back into KV caches, with layer-shared sparse memory attention; adapting Qwen3.5-4B cuts memory cache 1313x and prefill latency 6.9x at 1M context.
summary.zh: MemOnce 通过内存编码器-解码器仅缓存末层少量隐状态为紧凑记忆表示并按需解码回 KV 缓存，配合跨层仅计算一次稀疏索引的内存稀疏注意力，将 Qwen3.5-4B 适配后 1M 上下文下记忆缓存降低 1313 倍、prefill 延迟降低 6.9 倍，吞吐提升 3.5 倍、记忆性能提升 5.77%。

summary.en: VideoJSON converts each video minute into a JSON record via a VLM; at query time a coding agent writes sandboxed Python/Bash to filter and link records, beating MAGIC-Video by 7.0, 20.0, 24.75 points on three ultra-long video benchmarks.
summary.zh: VideoJSON 用视觉语言模型把每分钟视频转成含密集描述、事件、实体、地点和语音转录的 JSON 记录，查询时由 coding agent 在沙箱里写 Python/Bash 程序做多步过滤与关联；在四个超长视频基准上，配合 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 于 EgoLifeQA、Ego-R1-Bench、MM-Lifelong Week 分别超过 MAGIC-Video 7.0、20.0、24.75 分。

summary.en: AutoPILOT lets each model call emit a primitive action, an open-loop macro, or a closed-loop controller that keeps playing without further calls. On new AFK-Bench, GPT-6.1 Sol hits 68.6% real-time success versus VISTA's 38.3%, and 80.0% on GameWorld.
summary.zh: AutoPILOT 把 harness 的模型输出转成持续动作：模型可发原语动作、启动开环宏或写闭环控制器，在无新模型调用下继续玩；新建 AFK-Bench（120 款浏览器游戏），GPT-6.1 Sol 实时成功率 68.6%，VISTA 为 38.3%，GameWorld 保持 80.0% 而 VISTA 跌至 42.9%，并以五分之一 API 成本达到 VISTA 最终成功率。

summary.en: Feedback Shortcut combines state alignment, which projects multi-token prediction head states into feedback stand-ins, with pipelined correction that re-evaluates drafts during verification, staying within 10^-4 bits per byte of exact decoding on Paloma while speeding decoding 2.4-2.8x with ~2% extra training compute.
summary.zh: Feedback Shortcut 用 state alignment 训练轻量投影，把多 token 预测头状态映射为反馈替代量，再用 pipelined correction 在验证阶段重评草稿，在 135M 和 780M 模型上将 Paloma 上的 bpb 差距控制在 10^-4 内，并实现 2.4–2.8 倍解码加速，仅增约 2% 训练算力。

orgs.name: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

summary.en: A systematic study of autoresearch harness design shows context folding beats recency truncation by up to 19.2%, and MLEvolver, combining context folding with skill deletion, reaches 72.7% medal rate on MLE-Bench Lite and 94% fast1 on KernelBench Level 3.
summary.zh: 系统研究 autoresearch agent 的 harness 设计：对比上下文管理与技能管理策略，在 MLE-Bench 和 KernelBench 上发现 context folding 比近期截断基线最高提升 19.2%，结合技能删除的 MLEvolver 在 MLE-Bench Lite 达 72.7% 奖牌率、KernelBench Level 3 达 94% fast1。

summary.en: Scalable Beckmann Maps (SBM) adds classifier-free guidance and a scalable training recipe to Beckmann transport models for one-step sampling, reaching 1.6 one-step FID on ImageNet 256x256 with 3.2x fewer FLOPs than Improved-MeanFlow and 0.86 GenEval, and beating DriftWorld on robot-manipulation benchmarks.
summary.zh: Scalable Beckmann Maps (SBM) 将无分类器引导（CFG）与可扩展训练配方引入 Beckmann 传输模型，同时保持单次网络前向采样；在 ImageNet 256x256 上以无教师和特征损失方式从零训练，达到一步 FID 1.6，FLOPs 比 Improved-MeanFlow 基线少 3.2 倍，文本到图像 GenEval 得分 0.86，作为世界模型在两个机器人操作基准的五项指标上均优于 DriftWorld，训练算力减少 1.9–2.8 倍。

summary.en: Training neurosymbolic LM harnesses like RLM with RL on short tasks generalizes to 2-64x longer ones; RLM-27B, trained on synthetic data, beats Qwen3.8-27B by 26.9% on CTC-Bench and ExpertLongBench with ~2x fewer inference tokens.
summary.zh: 研究以神经符号式 harness 管理上下文的组合泛化能力：仅用短任务强化学习训练 RLM，即可泛化到长 2-64 倍的任务；用合成数据训练 RLM-27B，在 CTC-Bench 和 ExpertLongBench 上平均提升 Qwen3.8-27B 26.9%，推理 token 约减半。

summary.en: A training-free few-shot pineapple detector decodes frozen foundation-model features via a whitened foreground-background direction and adaptive thresholding, beating PET-DINO and GeCo2 at all support sizes and releasing the 4,908-frame Pineapple Plantation dataset.
summary.zh: 无需训练的小样本菠萝检测器把冻结视觉基础模型的稠密特征直接解码为检测框：用支持图像估计白化前景-背景方向打分查询patch，再自适应阈值与几何解码；在航拍菠萝影像上各支持样本数均优于PET-DINO和GeCo2，K=40时纯预测深度达DINOv2 RGB性能的92%，并发布含4,908帧的Pineapple Plantation数据集。

summary.en: Muted Distillation hides student reasoning from the teacher so scores are judged without distraction, cutting output tokens per episode by 57% and 53% versus on-policy distillation and raising SpreadsheetBench pass@1 by 4.8 points.
summary.zh: Muted Distillation（MD）隐藏学生的推理内容，让教师评分不受学生推理干扰，在多轮智能体任务中相比标准 OPD 将每回合输出 token 减少 57% 和 53%，在 SpreadsheetBench 上 pass@1 提升 4.8 分。

summary.en: Apsis statically analyzes agentic workflows by lifting framework-specific code into a unified intermediate representation and matching declarative bug patterns, achieving 91% precision and 84% recall and finding 36 previously unknown bugs.
summary.zh: Apsis 是一个静态安全分析器，将不同框架的 agentic workflow 代码提升为统一中间表示（语义图，含步骤、数据依赖与共享状态及行为属性），并用声明式 bug 描述语言匹配检测设计层面的 workflow 缺陷；在覆盖 13 个框架的 bug 语料基准上取得 91% 精确率与 84% 召回率，并在真实 workflow 中发现 36 个此前未知的 bug。

orgs.name: China University of Mining and Technology
Institute of Neuroscience, Chinese Academy of Sciences

summary.en: Open Vision Banana adapts Qwen-Image-2.1's 7B diffusion generator with one shared low-rank adapter into a unified depth and segmentation model; across 42 checkpoints, absolute scale stays unlearned (NYUv2 unaligned δ1 0.11–0.50, 0.516 with ten-seed ensemble) and validation flow loss anti-correlates with Cityscapes mIoU (Spearman ρ≈-0.9).
summary.zh: Open Vision Banana 将 Qwen-Image-2.1 的 7B 扩散生成器通过单一共享低秩适配器调成统一模型，覆盖深度、语义/实例/指代分割；在 42 个 checkpoint 上发现尺度未被学到（NYUv2 无对齐 δ1 仅 0.11–0.50，十种子集成提到 0.516），深度与分割争用适配器，验证 flow loss 与 Cityscapes mIoU 的 Spearman ρ≈-0.9，无法用于选型。

summary.en: AlpaSafe reuses a frozen driving VLA's last prefill token with a 1.7M-parameter head to score candidate trajectories and predict collision/offroad logits, cutting fault-collision or offroad rate from 6.41%/6.10% to 4.93% on 525 AlpaSim scenes at 0.75 ms per decision.
summary.zh: AlpaSafe 复用冻结驾驶 VLA 预填充阶段的最后一个隐藏 token，用 1.7M 参数的轻量头结合候选轨迹预测相对分数与碰撞/越界 logits，规则筛选后选出轨迹；在 525 个 AlpaSim 场景上把碰撞或越界率从 6.41%、6.10% 降至 4.93%，每次决策耗时 0.75 ms。

summary.en: VG3R turns the Wan2.1 video generation model into a feed-forward 3D reconstructor using clip-level shift prediction and a multi-layer camera head, achieving the lowest ATE and reconstruction errors among video-generation-based methods while running about 4x and 14x faster than Aether and Geo4D.
summary.zh: VG3R 将预训练视频生成模型 Wan2.1 改造为前馈 3D 重建模型，通过 clip-level shift prediction 校正解码逆深度的未知平移畸变、用多层 camera head 融合 Transformer 各层特征预测逐帧相机参数，无需迭代去噪，ATE 与重建误差在视频生成类方法中最低，比 Aether 和 Geo4D 分别快约 4 倍和 14 倍。

summary.en: EvoViM lets a frozen multimodal model recursively rewrite its interaction experience into a visual program that keeps and uses pixel evidence; it beats AutoMem by 31.3-47.6 points on six held-out tasks.
summary.zh: EvoViM 让冻结的多模态模型把自身交互经验递归改写为一份视觉程序，直接在像素上保留并调用视觉证据；在六项视觉匹配、空间回忆与序列决策任务上，其留出回合平均分比最强基线 AutoMem 高 31.3–47.6 分。

summary.en: Selecting few trajectories via skill-context coverage and ordered visual-decision similarity, on-policy distillation lifts a 4B visual agent from 49.17% to 82.08% on Navigation and 60.16% to 85.55% on Sokoban, recovering over 90% of the gap to a 27B teacher.
summary.zh: 用技能-上下文覆盖度与有序视觉决策相似度筛选少量轨迹，结合on-policy distillation训练视觉agent；仅4条固定轨迹即将4B学生在Navigation上从49.17%提升至82.08%、Sokoban从60.16%提升至85.55%，恢复对27B教师90%以上的差距。

summary.en: Extending LatentQA to diffusion activations, DAO translates denoising activations into natural-language answers, describing final image content from early steps and steering generation toward target attributes.
summary.zh: 将 LatentQA 任务扩展到扩散模型激活，提出 DAO 把去噪激活翻译成自然语言回答，可从早期去噪步激活描述最终图像内容，并能引导生成目标属性、用 attribution patching 定位相关组件。

orgs.name: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

summary.en: PROSPER uses LLMs as sparse retrievers with a literal residual network to curb semantic expansion hallucination and a lexical focusing window for top-k early sparsification, outperforming existing sparse retrievers in offline and online A/B tests.
summary.zh: PROSPER 将 LLM 用作稀疏检索器，通过字面残差网络补偿被低估的字面词、抑制语义扩展幻觉，并用词法聚焦窗口做 top-k 早期稀疏化，在离线评测与大尺度在线 A/B 测试中稳定优于现有稀疏检索器并提升工业混合检索收入。

orgs.name: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

summary.en: S-Mind internalizes multi-view geometry in MLLMs via compact spatial tokens that hold a fused 3D scene and re-express it per viewpoint, gaining up to 22.26 points on four spatial benchmarks and running ~100x faster than a tool-based agent.
summary.zh: S-Mind 用一组紧凑的空间 token 把多视角几何内化进 MLLM，监督这些 token 承载融合后的 3D 场景并在推理中重表达各视角，在四个空间基准上平均准确率较 Qwen3.5 骨干最高提升 22.26 分，融合与视角变换准确率达 65.11% 和 82.17%，基线至多 16.02% 和 37.28%，推理比工具型 agent 快约 100 倍。

orgs.name: Huazhong University of Science and Technology

summary.en: Short chain-of-thought turns spatial VQA into transcription: once a VLM writes a spatial relation, answers follow that sentence over the image. Across 15 open and 6 closed models, false relations and conclusion mis-mapping cause four in five CoT losses; frontier models re-ground after writing.
summary.zh: 研究发现短链式思维把空间VQA变成转写问题：VLM一旦写出空间关系便依从该句而非图像。在15个开源模型与6个闭源前沿模型上，写作会削弱“越低越近”启发式并丢弃有效线索，结论句还可能反转正确关系，错误关系与结论映射占CoT损失的八成；Qwen3-VL-32B同样如此，闭源模型则无此损，且六分之三在写作后会重新检查图像。

summary.en: RecallWorld jointly reconstructs multi-view episodes into Scenelets with episode-independent geometry, retrieving complementary memory via coverage and geometric visibility; it improves revisit PSNR by 2.6 dB (partial) and 3.9 dB (full cycles) over the strongest baseline on four datasets.
summary.zh: RecallWorld 将多视角短片段联合重建为 Scenelet 以保持跨片段几何独立，并用基于覆盖率的检索与几何可见性判断融合历史记忆；在四个数据集上重访 PSNR 比最强基线提升 2.6 dB（部分重访）和 3.9 dB（完整环游）。

summary.en: MASSys benchmarks multi-agent LLM workflows across serving substrates and load regimes on five task families, tracking quality, latency, cost, and failures; under KV-cache pressure, Star drops from first to fourth in latency rank while Chain rises from fourth to first.
summary.zh: MASSys 在多种 serving substrate 与负载条件下对同一批多智能体 LLM 工作流运行五类任务，记录质量、时延、成本与失败证据；在 KV-cache 压力下 Star 的平均延迟排名从第一跌至第四，Chain 则从第四升至第一。

summary.en: KMed-31B post-trains an open-weight model by splitting medical tasks into four feedback-based categories, training specialists, then merging them via Multi-teacher On-policy Delta Distillation; HealthBench Hard rises from 22.95 to 41.87.
summary.zh: KMed-31B 从开放权重模型后训练而来，按输出形式与反馈类型把医学任务分为四类，各类训练专用专家模型，再用 Multi-teacher On-policy Delta Distillation (MOPD$^2$) 合并为单一学生模型；非思考模式下 HealthBench Hard 由 22.95 升至 41.87，Professional 由 37.92 升至 50.20，四个多选题医学基准持平或略升。

summary.en: Entangle converts robot videos into matched human contexts via video-to-video generation and trains an in-context world-action model with variable-length windows and intra-task contrastive objectives, scoring 83.5/100 on six unseen Astribot S1 tasks and 69.5% success on seven unseen RoboTwin tasks, 22.6 points above Zero-WAM.
summary.zh: Entangle 用视频到视频生成把机器人视频转成匹配的人类示范上下文，并结合变长视频窗口与任务内对比目标训练上下文世界-动作模型，在 Astribot S1 的六个未见任务上平均得分 83.5/100，在七个 RoboTwin 未见任务上平均成功率 69.5%，比 Zero-WAM 高 22.6 个百分点。

summary.en: 3DCodeFactory synthesizes 3D reference images from raw text, derives modeling specs and interaction requirements, and auto-scores multi-turn agent rollouts, releasing 5,045 instances; fine-tuned Qwen models beat existing open 3D code data on BlenderWorld, P3D-Bench and 3DCodeBench.
summary.zh: 3DCodeFactory 用图像生成器把原始文本变成 3D 参考图，再据此构建建模规格与交互需求，并联合视觉、规格、功能三类评分规则自动筛选多轮 agent 轨迹，产出 5,045 条 3DCodeFactory-Data；微调 Qwen3.5-9B 与 Qwen3.8-27B 后在 BlenderWorld、P3D-Bench、3DCodeBench 上稳定超过现有开源 3D 代码数据训练的模型，27B 模型整体性能还超过同系列 Qwen3.8-Max。

summary.en: ArgsWorld is an autoregressive diffusion world model that jointly outputs an explicit 3DGS scene per chunk; with 3D Self-Forcing Distillation it unifies reconstruction, generation, and camera extrapolation, achieving state-of-the-art results on multiple 3D scene modeling tasks.
summary.zh: ArgsWorld 是自回归扩散世界模型，每个生成块联合处理干净历史图像 latent 与新视角噪声 latent，并刷新场景特征以输出显式 3DGS；配合 3D Self-Forcing Distillation 在自生成历史上训练，统一了重建、生成与相机外推，多项 3D 场景建模任务达到 SOTA。

summary.en: Self-WSP lets Qwen3.5-0.8B read and edit its own weights, raising GSM8K accuracy from 11.8% to 62.2% and MATH500 from 7.0% to 32.2%, sometimes via only 16 parameters; however, gains lack interpretability and random-search WSP performs comparably.
summary.zh: Self-WSP 让 Qwen3.5-0.8B 读取并编辑自身权重，在 GSM8K 上将准确率从 11.8% 提升至 62.2%，在 MATH500 上从 7.0% 提升至 32.2%，有时仅改动 16 个参数；但模型对编辑缺乏理解，随机搜索驱动的 WSP 效果相近，可解释性仍欠缺。

summary.en: JudiAct frames multimodal safety intervention as four actions (allow, warn, review, refuse), building 20,126 training audits and JudiBench; it improves request and answer Macro-F1 by over 28 points over its 4B backbone and cuts MM-SafetyBench attack success from 40.78% to 25.30%.
summary.zh: JudiAct 将多模态安全干预分为 allow、warn、review、refuse 四类动作，构建 20,126 条审计训练语料与 JudiBench，先分别陈述来源证据、适用条件与规则适用再核对原始输入，在 JudiBench 上 request 与 answer 的 Macro-F1 较 4B 骨干提升超 28 个百分点，并将 MM-SafetyBench 攻击成功率从 40.78% 降至 25.30%。

summary.en: CivilCADBench benchmarks multimodal LLMs on real civil engineering drawing sets with understanding, reconstruction, and design tasks; top models exceed 90% on understanding and single-page reconstruction but reach only 60% on layer assignment and 48% on design.
summary.zh: CivilCADBench 基于真实土木工程图纸与含 25 万以上 CAD 实体的源文件构建，包含理解、重建与设计三类任务，用确定性评分器对比几何、图层、文字与尺寸；七个前沿 MLLM 在理解与单页重建上超过 90%，但图层分配仅 60%、设计仅 48%。

orgs.name: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

summary.en: Paintress couples an executable geometric proxy with a separate 3D Gaussian appearance memory in a shared metric frame, separating writing from reading; on Expedition-33 it reaches 0.1220 ROI-LPIPS and 52.12% detail retention versus CWM's 0.2731 and 10.91%.
summary.zh: Paintress 将可执行几何代理与独立参数的 3D 高斯外观记忆耦合在同一度量坐标系中，通过写读分离保持已访问地点的外观一致；在 Expedition-33 基准上，其 ROI-LPIPS 为 0.1220、细节保留率 52.12%，远优于 CWM 的 0.2731 和 10.91%。

summary.en: SANA-Robot is a 4.5B world action model combining linear-attention global memory with sliding-window softmax attention for minute-level hybrid memory at constant cost, achieving top RoboDojo memory results and LIBERO-Plus/Pro/Max success rates, running 30 Hz closed-loop on edge devices.
summary.zh: SANA-Robot 是一个 4.5B 的世界动作模型，通过线性注意力维持固定大小的全局记忆、滑动窗口 softmax 注意力传递历史信息，实现分钟级混合记忆与恒定开销推理；在 RoboDojo 记忆维度上取得中等规模模型最佳表现，并在 LIBERO-Plus、LIBERO-Pro、LIBERO-Max 上取得最高成功率，RTX 5090 上单动作块推理耗时 135 ms（FP8）/115 ms（NVFP4），边缘设备实现 30 Hz 闭环实时控制。

orgs.name: A*STAR Centre for Frontier AI Research

summary.en: NightWatch pairs any computer-use agent with a 0.8B System-1 watcher that streams interface state, cutting OSWorld wall-clock time 33% and wasted time 53% at equal success, and lifting DynaCU-Bench success from 39.5% to 44.2%.
summary.zh: NightWatch 让任意 CUA 挂载 0.8B 的 System-1 监控器，流式跟踪界面状态以弥合感知-动作间隙；在 OSWorld 上非推理实际耗时降 33%、浪费时间降 53% 且成功率持平，DynaCU-Bench 上大模型成功率从 39.5% 升至 44.2%。

orgs.name: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence

summary.en: EmoRouter, a training-free, model-agnostic adaptive modality cascading framework, uses Conformal Prediction uncertainty to pick per-utterance exit tiers with Conformal Set Contraction calibration, matching full-modality accuracy on 4 MER benchmarks and 3 Omni-LLMs while cutting latency 67.9–94.5%.
summary.zh: EmoRouter 是一个免训练、与模型无关的自适应模态级联框架，依据 Conformal Prediction 估计的不确定性为每句话选择退出层级，并用 Conformal Set Contraction 校准各层级误差预算；在 4 个 MER 基准、3 个 Omni-LLM 上，它匹配或超过全模态效果，同时将推理延迟降低 67.9–94.5%。

summary.en: H2O and StreamingLLM are unified as endpoints of a power-law token score; NoHairCache calibrates the exponent once, bounds it via the no-hair mechanism, and achieves the lowest perplexity across three datasets without per-dataset tuning.
summary.zh: 将 H2O 与 StreamingLLM 统一为幂律打分 s_i=A_i·(t-i)^{-α} 的两个端点，用 no-hair 机制界定 α 范围，Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 在 WikiText 上只需校准一次得 [0.556,0.822]；NoHairCache 在三个数据集上免调参取得最低 PPL，预算 512 时比 StreamingLLM 低 0.06–0.10。

summary.en: Mirrored Min-of-K (MMoK) adds one extra model sample to MoK training and subtracts its nearest-candidate distance, recovering distributions MoK cannot; validated on synthetic mixtures, trajectory prediction, cyclone forecasting, robotic policy learning, and ambiguous segmentation.
summary.zh: 镜像 Min-of-K（MMoK）在 MoK 训练中额外采样一个候选并按最近候选规则选取、再减去该距离，弥补候选间相对位置信息缺失；理论上可恢复 MoK 无法恢复的数据分布，在合成混合、轨迹预测、热带气旋预报、机器人策略学习和医学图像分割五类任务上验证有效。

summary.en: PBPT trains multiple LLMs in parallel with population-based hyperparameter tuning: periodically evaluate, duplicate and perturb top performers, replace losers. It beats compute-matched independent RLVR learners on Enigmata, Nemotron, Gaia2 and AppWorld, recovering from poor initial hyperparameters.
summary.zh: PBPT 并行训练多个模型，并通过基于种群的训练（population-based training）自动调节超参数：定期在验证集上评估模型，复制表现好的并扰动其超参数，淘汰表现差的；在 Enigmata、Nemotron 和 Gaia2、AppWorld 上，它训练的 agent 强于同等算力下独立训练的 RLVR 模型，并能从较差的初始超参数中恢复。

summary.en: UNIFIED folds encoding, generation and decoding into one shared diffusion transformer trained from scratch with only reconstruction and flow-matching losses, reaching 2.08 gFID on ImageNet-1K 256x256 and 0.87 GenEval.
summary.zh: UNIFIED 将编码、生成、解码三个模式统一到单个共享骨干的扩散 Transformer 中，仅用重建与流匹配损失从零训练；在 ImageNet-1K 256×256 上，约 215M 参数时 gFID 达 2.08，优于 UNITE，且 UNIFIED-B 在文本到图像 GenEval 上取得 0.87。

summary.en: PlanNudge freezes a pretrained diffusion driving planner and trains a lightweight MLP nudge policy to adjust speed and curvature, matching or beating prior RL finetuning on all six nuPlan settings with ~1/6 environment steps.
summary.zh: PlanNudge 冻结预训练的扩散规划器，只用轻量 MLP nudge 策略在闭环中单次前向输出速度与曲率调整，在 nuPlan 六个设置上追平或超过此前最优 RL 微调方法，环境步数约 1/6、计算量不到 1/5。

summary.en: PyraFault benchmarks cross-magnification provenance verification with 3.06M examples from 2,200 TCGA cases; ZoomTrace recovers observation sources before checking claimed locations, reaching 0.969 AUPRC and 0.987 AUROC versus 0.789 and 0.903 for Efficient LoFTR.
summary.zh: 构建 PyraFault 基准（五支 TCGA 队列共 2200 例、306 万坐标监督样本）来评测跨放大倍率溯源验证 CMPV，并提出先估计来源再比对声称位置的 ZoomTrace；在 503,320 个测试样本上 AUPRC 0.969、AUROC 0.987，Efficient LoFTR 为 0.789 和 0.903。

summary.en: ContextFact links context-preserving fact memories with source-grounded entity representations, reconstructing entities across sessions and reranking fact and entity views at query time; with Qwen3.5-27B it reaches 86.49% on LoCoMo and 91.00% on LongMemEval-S using only 21% of the strongest baseline's evidence tokens.
summary.zh: ContextFact 将保留上下文的事实记忆与有源实体表示结合：会话内为每条事实收集解读所需上下文，跨会话对齐指代并回溯源对话重建实体表示；查询时分别重排事实与实体视图并做实体链接扩展。以 Qwen3.5-27B 为骨干，在 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval-S 上分别取得 86.49% 和 91.00% 的 judge 准确率，仅用最强基线 21% 的证据 token。

summary.en: PhyCoVE benchmarks physical counterfactual video editing with 533 cases across rigid, elastic, and fluid dynamics and proposes counterfactual fidelity; seven video editing models, even the best reproducing only about one seventh of physical change, remain far from solved.
summary.zh: PhyCoVE 构建了 533 个物理反事实视频编辑用例的基准，覆盖刚体、弹性体和流体及其五种交互模式，并提出反事实保真度指标；在该基准上评测七个视频编辑模型，发现其排名与人类偏好接近，但最佳模型仅复现约七分之一的物理变化。

summary.en: DriveTTO is a training-free test-time search that refines native driving proposals in shrinking neighborhoods, fusing planner and control branches only when both frozen scorers predict gains, recovering nonzero PDMS in 51.35% of zero-score Navtest cases.
summary.zh: DriveTTO 是一种免训练方法，围绕原生轨迹提案在逐渐缩小的邻域内重采样，并用冻结的评分器在到达的终点评估完整路径；通过融合规划器提案分支与车辆控制扰动分支，在双评分器都预测提升时才接受更新。Navtest 上原生零分场景平均 51.35% 恢复非零 PDMS，零分率从 1.63% 降至 1.13%，并取得 95.54 PDMS。

summary.en: GameAnything is an open-source agentic platform that turns multimodal inspirations into playable extensions of existing games via iterative development with coding agents, a playtesting critic, and experience memory; GameAnything-Bench evaluates nine coding agent configurations, which adapt references but still struggle with playable interactions and precise edits.
summary.zh: GameAnything 是一个开源的智能体平台，将多模态灵感通过迭代开发转化为现有游戏的可玩扩展，结合编码智能体、独立的试玩评审、持久开发状态与可复用经验记忆；配套 GameAnything-Bench 评测 9 种编码智能体配置，发现它们能适配参考内容，但在可玩交互与精确修改上仍显不足。

orgs.name: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)

summary.en: Tacinf unifies tactile simulation, the Tabero benchmark, VTLA policy learning, handheld Tacumi collection, and Taco sim-to-real evaluation; simulation-only tactile tuning transfers zero-shot, with sim-real success correlating at r=0.998 and mixed data lifting real success from 20% to 60%.
summary.zh: Tacinf 是一套面向力感知操作的低成本模块化基础设施，统一了仿真数据合成与触觉基准 Tabero、VTLA 策略学习、手持采集设备 Tacumi 和 sim-to-real 评测 Taco；仅用仿真触觉数据微调的基础模型可零样本迁移到真实任务，8 个策略的仿真与真机成功率相关系数 r=0.998，混合遥操作、仿真与 Tacumi 数据后真机成功率从 20% 升至 60%。

summary.en: REINFORCE Look Back (RLB) uses counterfactual world models to predict outcomes under alternative actions and counterfactual returns as baselines, provably reducing variance and separating action effects from environmental luck.
summary.zh: REINFORCE Look Back (RLB) 策略梯度估计器，用反事实世界模型预测同一环境随机性下替换动作后的结果，并以反事实回报作为基线分离动作效应与环境运气，证明其无偏性与方差缩减条件。在环境演化比动作影响更难预测时，反事实世界模型比普通世界模型更易学习并带来更好的策略学习。

orgs.name: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)
University of Electronic Science and Technology of China

summary.en: RadioWorld transfers a world model to synthesize RF radiance fields via a dual-stream Mixture-of-Transformers, encoding 3D geometry and transceiver locations without reference measurements; it also introduces UrbanRF-Bench (657 scenes, 32,850 fields) and clearly outperforms specialized baselines in unseen cities.
summary.zh: RadioWorld 用双流 Mixture-of-Transformers 架构把世界模型迁移到射频辐射场合成，Scene-Understanding Transformer 编码 3D 场景几何与收发机位置，Field-Generation Transformer 据此生成射频场，无需参考测量；并构建覆盖 657 个城市场景、32,850 个射频场的 UrbanRF-Bench，在未见城市上显著优于专用基线。

summary.en: GALILEO transports each key's 3D position to query time via estimated velocity before positional encoding, plugging into RayRoPE and URoPE; in LVSM it improves dynamic view synthesis on Syn4D, dynamic Objaverse, and Stereo4D.
summary.zh: GALILEO 用伽利略平移把每个 key 的 3D 位置按估计速度和时间偏移搬到查询时刻，再做位置编码，因此可直接接入 RayRoPE 与 URoPE；在 LVSM 上提升 Syn4D、动态 Objaverse 和 Stereo4D 的动态视图合成，并降低 3D 点跟踪误差。

summary.en: NanoAstra trains VLMs for generalizable manipulation via semantic action modeling and capability-preserving SFT, reaching 17.8% zero-shot success on RoboTwin 2.0 and cutting robot idle time from 35.0% to 6.9%.
summary.zh: nanoAstra 以语义动作建模和 CP-SFT 训练 VLM 用于通用机器人操作，在 RoboTwin 2.0 随机化基准上 zero-shot 成功率达 17.8%，优于先进 VLA 与 WAM 基线，并在单张 H20 GPU 上实现流式执行，将机器人空闲时间从 35.0% 降至 6.9%。

summary.en: Polytropos reconstructs VLM descriptions of 374 cultural objects into images and compares them with originals: reconstructions are read as the recorded culture 54.55%-59.09% of the time versus 52.14% for photos, yet only 0.49% match the specific object.
summary.zh: Polytropos 基准将 VLM 对文物的描述重建为图像并与原照片比对，覆盖 374 件文物、5 个模型共 1,870 条描述及 230 条策展人描述；重建图被认作所记录文化的比例为 54.55%–59.09%，高于照片的 52.14%，但仅 0.49% 能对应到具体物件。

orgs.name: The University of Texas at Austin

summary.en: Paired non-contrast and contrast-enhanced medical images show MLLM attention maps can match while answers differ, making value-retrieved visual content key; VIVID distills teacher corrections via enhanced visual values, beating prior on-policy distillation across six test sets with non-contrast-only inference.
summary.zh: 利用配对平扫与增强医学图像的对比表明，MLLM 的注意力图相同答案却不同，通过视觉 value 检索的内容关键；VIVID 用增强视觉 value 筛选教师修正做 on-policy 蒸馏，六个测试集上优于现有方法且推理只需平扫图像。

orgs.name: Singapore University of Technology and Design

summary.en: MusicListenBench evaluates audio LLMs on paired melody, harmony, timbre, and tempo tests with FLIP/STAY variants; open models stay near the 50% floor, Gemini 2.5 Pro reaches 74.2% versus humans' 87.0%, and GRPO lifts Qwen2.5-Omni from 61.2% to 99.0% but only 86.0% on FLIP/STAY.
summary.zh: MusicListenBench 用旋律、和声、音色、节奏的成对听力测试评测音频 LLM，FLIP/STAY 变体对照使忽略音频者只得 50%；渲染测试上 8 个开源模型 7 个贴近该下限，最佳 Gemini 2.5 Pro 达 74.2%，低于人类 87.0%；GRPO 微调 Qwen2.5-Omni 从 61.2% 升到 99.0%，但 FLIP/STAY 仅 86.0%，静音噪声导致 25.7% 误翻转。

summary.en: Contact Harness guides VLM agents with reusable optimized skills and compliant force-feedback execution to assess contact states and act, requiring no fine-tuning or demonstrations; it achieves 90.7% full insertion across 15 connectors and 96.7% in simulation, beating fine-tuned VLA baselines' 68.3%.
summary.zh: Contact Harness 用可复用的优化技能引导 VLM agent 结合力觉与视觉判断接触状态并选择动作，配合实时力反馈的柔顺执行，无需微调或示范；在 GPT-6 Astra 驱动 Rokae 与 Franka 的零样本真机实验中，15 类连接器全插入率 90.7%，四个接触任务平均成功率 100%，六项仿真任务 96.7%，超过微调 VLA 基线的最高 68.3%。

summary.en: Adapting Predict-and-Perturb self-refinement from video generation to VLA models boosts SmolVLA on 400 LIBERO episodes by 5.3 points, with episode-level uncertainty predicting failure at AUC 0.851.
summary.zh: 将原本用于视频生成的 Predict-and-Perturb 自精炼流程适配到 VLA 模型，针对机器人数据结构修改精炼过程；在 LIBERO 的 400 个 episode 上用 SmolVLA 评测，成功率比原始基线高 5.3 个百分点，episode 级不确定性预测失败 AUC 达 0.851。

summary.en: PINE, a one-step Omni Diffusion Transformer, jointly predicts point maps, surface normals, and instance maps in a single forward pass using stream masks, camera-ray encoding, and DINOv3-grounded attention; trained on 139K synthetic images, it achieves state-of-the-art point maps and runs 5.7x faster than MoGe-3 with SAM.
summary.zh: PINE 用一步 Omni Diffusion Transformer 单次前向同时预测点图、表面法线和实例图，以流掩码控制各 token 流交互，并用相机感知射线编码和 DINOv3 特征注意力；仅用 139K 合成图像训练，即在点图上取得最优，在大型物体分割上超过 SAM，且比 MoGe-3 加 SAM 快 5.7 倍。

orgs.name: University of Science and Technology of China

summary.en: Studying which path to align in Priming's one-step generators, aligning the paired reconstruction path with a frozen DINOv2 encoder outperforms aligning the generative path, yielding RePrime with FID 1.30 (B) and 1.155 (L) on ImageNet 256×256.
summary.zh: 在 Priming 框架上研究一步生成器的表示对齐路径选择，发现对齐生成路径会使 recall 从 0.45 降至 0.15–0.25，而对齐配对重建路径配合冻结 DINOv2 编码器在全部设置下均有效，RePrime 在 ImageNet 256×256 上将 FID 降至 1.30（B）与 1.155（L）。

orgs.name: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems

summary.en: A finite-horizon last-iterate bound for rotational learning-rate schedules on a geodesically convex sphere yields a unique optimal schedule approaching linear decay, predicting schedule ordering for Adam/Muon and Hyperball optimizers and motivating a new schedule outperforming cosine and WSD.
summary.zh: 在测地凸的球面设定下，为任意旋转型学习率调度推导末次迭代收敛界，得到使该界最小、且随训练步数增长趋近线性衰减的唯一调度；据此预测并验证 AdamH/MuonH 下线性衰减强于 WSD，而 Adam/Muon 因参数范数动态变化仍适合 WSD，并导出一个优于 cosine 和 WSD 的新调度。

orgs.name: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems

summary.en: Exact norm dynamics under decoupled weight decay reveal that multi-timescale momentum raises parameter norms and controls rotation speed, acting as an endogenous annealing schedule; interventions confirm this drives AdEMAMix's gains over AdamW in language-model pretraining.
summary.zh: 从解耦权重衰减下的精确范数动力学出发，揭示多时间尺度动量记忆通过改变参数范数控制参数旋转速度，独立加权的慢动量显著提升参数范数却几乎不影响瞬时更新，从而充当内生的退火调度；在 AdEMAMix 语言模型预训练中的干预实验证实该机制是其优于 AdamW 的重要因素。

summary.en: KernelShift benchmarks coding agents on 99 real-world CPU kernels across Arm Neon, SVE, SVE2, and SME2. Agents beat auto-vectorized compilers by 2.4-19.8x and ncnn by up to 2.74x, but trail KleidiAI at 0.70x and struggle with SME2.
summary.zh: KernelShift 构建了跨 CPU 架构演进的 kernel 优化基准，从 ncnn、llama.cpp 等真实仓库提取 99 个 kernel，让编码 agent 在 Arm Neon/SVE/SVE2/SME2 上优化代码；agent 在成熟扩展上比自动向量化编译器快 2.4–19.8x、比 ncnn Neon kernel 快至 2.74x，但仍落后 KleidiAI 手工内核（0.70x），且难以适配 SME2 矩阵瓦片等陌生编程模型。

summary.en: Dr. Grasp-RL trains a simple PPO MLP policy with a time-reversed curriculum and coordinated reset to learn diverse, closed-loop dexterous grasps from ~400 objects, generalizing to 20,000+ unseen objects.
summary.zh: Dr. Grasp-RL 用时间反转课程与协调重置机制训练 PPO 下的简单 MLP 策略，在约 400 个物体上学习多样且闭环的灵巧抓取，并在 20,000 多个未见物体上展现强泛化。

summary.en: Mass Forcing shifts on-policy DMD supervision from whole videos to individual states, reweighting branched rollouts by latent-space score-integrated density ratios and reaching 83% Dynamic Degree on MovieGen and VBench versus 12-32% for baselines.
summary.zh: Mass Forcing 将 on-policy DMD 监督从整段视频细化到单个状态，用潜空间 score 积分估计师生密度比重加权分支 rollout，并在 MovieGen 与 VBench 上将 Dynamic Degree 提升至 83%，基线仅 12–32%。

summary.en: Wactorz is an open-source runtime making LLM-generated agents long-lived supervised actors: a planner compiles chat requests into Python actors, a supervisor restarts crashed ones state intact, and MQTT coordination enables spawning and live migration across edge nodes like Raspberry Pi, demonstrated in under four minutes for $0.13.
summary.zh: Wactorz 是一个开源运行时，把 LLM 生成的 agent 变成长期存活的受监督 actor：planner 将聊天请求转成 Python 并在运行时编译为新 actor，supervisor 在崩溃时单独重启并保留状态；协调全部基于 MQTT，支持在 Raspberry Pi 等边缘节点上生成与实时迁移 agent，演示中四分钟内完成从单条请求搭建摄像头到灯的自动化、自动布线并自主修复除零 bug、以及迁移到新节点，模型花费 0.13 美元。

summary.en: SuperFine3D learns a shared global-local recursive refinement operator trained only on 512^3–1024^3 representations to generate extremely detailed 3D geometry at 4096^3 decoder-grid resolution, achieving 9.4x inference speedup and 23.0% lower peak GPU memory than a full-attention recursive baseline.
summary.zh: SuperFine3D 通过全局-局部递归细化学习共享细化算子，在仅用 $512^3$–$1024^3$ 表示训练的情况下生成 $4096^3$ 解码器网格分辨率的高精细 3D 几何，结合空间单元注意力与跨尺度引导，端到端推理相比全注意力基线加速 9.4 倍、峰值显存降低 23.0%。

summary.en: Fin-RSI is a unified Python library of financial skills, checks, and self-improvement for LLM agents; tool discovery raises valid-program episodes from 9.7% to 29.2%, and from 23.6% to 64.6% for models above 14B.
summary.zh: Fin-RSI 构建面向 LLM 智能体的统一 Python 金融工具库，整合市场分析、预测、组合构建与交易研究，并支持工具发现、校验与自我改进；在 20 个开放权重模型、六项持仓任务上，工具发现使产出有效程序的比例从 9.7% 升至 29.2%，14B 以上模型从 23.6% 升至 64.6%。

orgs.name: Made In Alexandria AI Team (M.I.A Robotics)

summary.en: ApexID, a hierarchical SphereFace2-based loss combining global identity discrimination with balanced animal-category supervision, uses 132,533 images from 19 public datasets and four external test sets, reaching 64.89% dataset-averaged Rank-1 with ConvNeXt-Small and 32.54% mAP with MIEW-ID, both above pretrained references, and best elephant retrieval among fourteen configurations.
summary.zh: ApexID 采用基于 SphereFace2 的分层损失，将全局身份判别与均衡的动物类别监督结合，在 132,533 张图像、19 个公开数据集上训练，并在四个外部数据集上评测；ConvNeXt-Small 搭配该损失取得数据集平均 Rank-1 64.89%，MIEW-ID 取得 mAP 32.54%，均高于各自的预训练参考模型，在大象这一未参与动物 Re-ID 训练的类别上，该变体在十四种配置中检索表现最佳。

summary.en: ComplexIF is a multi-turn, multi-constraint instruction-following benchmark built by an automatic pipeline that expands seed requests into conversations with woven constraints; even the strongest of 14 models fully satisfies fewer than half of verifiable tasks, with no model leading on both splits.
summary.zh: ComplexIF 是一个多轮多约束指令遵循基准，通过自动流水线把种子请求扩展为多轮对话并织入约束，只保留强模型可解的任务；14 个模型中最强者在可验证子集上完全满足约束的任务不足一半，且无模型在两个子集上同时领先。

summary.en: Notes on proving agents Rethlas, Danus, Pharos and verification agent OSVerify: design principles, comparisons with base models, case studies, usage, plus a brief history of AI for mathematics.
summary.zh: 围绕数学证明智能体 Rethlas、Danus、Pharos 与验证智能体 OSVerify，说明其设计原则、与基座模型的对比及使用方式，并回顾 AI for mathematics 的历史与社区反应。

summary.en: Auditing an agentic anti-money-laundering LLM pipeline on Elliptic++ Bitcoin data, decision-source attribution shows a deterministic wallet-score override carries ~94% of flagging credit and the LLM judge's citations pass checks despite being inapplicable.
summary.zh: 在 Elliptic++ Bitcoin 数据集上审计由规则、检索和 LLM 判官组成的反洗钱 agentic pipeline，用决策来源归因发现确定性钱包分数覆盖贡献约 94% 的标记信用，且 LLM 判官的引证检查会放过不适用的监管条款。

summary.en: Arcadian is an open-source humanoid ecosystem featuring metal-embedded 3D printing, costing around $6,800. It demonstrates successful sim2real transfer of an RL locomotion policy and supports VR teleoperation.
summary.zh: Arcadian是一个开源的人形机器人生态系统，采用金属嵌入式3D打印技术实现了高强度与低成本的平衡，总造价约6800美元。通过仿真训练的强化学习 locomotion 策略成功迁移至硬件，并支持通过VR进行双臂操作。

summary.en: Motion Mamba 2.0 combines Mamba recurrent states with persistent content memory for autoregressive root-body diffusion, enabling terminal control over 39.52 s rollouts; CUDA Graph optimizations cut latency from 1685.35 to 276.14 ms (6.138x median speedup), validated on Unitree G1.
summary.zh: Motion Mamba 2.0 用 Mamba 循环状态加持久内容记忆 PCM 做根-身体扩散式自回归动作生成，支持最长 39.52 s 的长程末端控制；配合 CUDA Graph 等优化，RTX 4090 上完整窗口延迟从 1685.35 ms 降到 276.14 ms，中位加速 6.138 倍，并在 Unitree G1 上验证了文本引导动作组合与交互式行走。

summary.en: SuperNav-1.5 introduces a structured spatial memory system with area-segmented occupancy maps and memory nodes for efficient multi-session and multi-goal navigation, outperforming baselines in path efficiency and real-world robot deployment.
summary.zh: SuperNav-1.5 采用一种由区域分割占用图和记忆节点构成的结构化空间记忆系统，结合智能体引导的重定位技术，实现了高效的跨会话及多目标导航。实验表明其在单目标、多目标及需求驱动导航基准上超越基线，显著提升了路径效率，并成功部署于真实四足机器人。

summary.en: SAGE-Drive adaptively invokes explicit reasoning for autonomous driving planning based on predicted benefits, achieving near-full-reasoning accuracy at a fraction of the computational cost.
summary.zh: SAGE-Drive 框架通过结合初始轨迹几何特征与多模态场景信息预测显式推理的益处，在限定计算预算下自适应地选择何时调用显式推理。在 35% 的预算下，其平均位移误差达到 1.5148 m，接近全场景推理的效果。

summary.en: TeleMultiStream integrates multi-stream WebRTC video feedback and UDP pose downlink to achieve a low glass-to-glass latency of 60-66 ms in wired LAN tests, supporting efficient robot demonstration data collection.
summary.zh: TeleMultiStream集成多路WebRTC视频反馈与UDP位姿下行，通过缓冲区复用与原生XR渲染降低延迟，在有线局域网测试中将端到端延迟降至60至66毫秒，较参考系统降低高达26.8%，有效支持具身智能示范数据采集。

orgs.name: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences

summary.en: DivDynBench benchmarks rigging and motion generation across six morphology categories; an Agentic Motion Framework has an agent write skeleton and motion programs while a deterministic executor handles rigging and kinematics, improving reliability and control accuracy.
summary.zh: DivDynBench，覆盖六类形态的绑定与运动生成基准，对比专用生成、视频生成后运动恢复与 agent 驱动三种范式；据此设计 Agentic Motion Framework，由 agent 编写骨架与运动程序，确定性执行器完成绑定与运动学求解，降低生成开销并提升绑定可靠性与运动控制精度。

summary.en: OWE-Bench offers 26 expert-written long-horizon engineering tasks scored on speed, cost and accuracy over visible and hidden cases; Claude Fable 5.2 leads at 54.6% using 211M tokens per task, with an 18-point deployment gap on hidden cases that models overestimate by 21 points.
summary.zh: OWE-Bench 汇集软件、物理、机器学习与科学计算领域的 26 个长周期工程任务，按速度、成本与准确率在公开及隐藏用例上评分；最强模型 Claude Fable 5.2 得 54.6%，每题平均耗 211M tokens，隐藏用例分数平均低 18 分（部署差距），模型自身高估该差距 21 分。

summary.en: FlexWAM improves real-world manipulation success by dynamically routing visual attention across multi-camera views using observation-conditioned routing and counterfactual view credit.
summary.zh: FlexWAM通过交替视角注意力、观察条件路由动作注意力和基于反事实视角信用的评价器，动态优先处理最相关的多相机视角，在五个真实世界的抓取任务中将平均成功率提升了16.4和23.0个百分点。

summary.en: SpikingWAM uses a sparse task skeleton as the world state to achieve energy-efficient robotic manipulation with competitive success rates across multiple benchmarks.
summary.zh: SpikingWAM利用稀疏任务骨架作为世界状态，结合主体帧尖峰编码与网格重合注意力机制，在模拟和真实机器人抓取基准测试中以极低能耗实现了与传统人工神经网络竞争力的成功率，并在LIBERO-Plus上超越了所有对比方法。

summary.en: Agent on Guard (AoG) is a hierarchical framework that improves collaboration between base policies and programming agents, achieving a 50.57% success rate and reducing latency by 80.4% on RoboDojo-Sim.
summary.zh: Agent on Guard (AoG) 是一个分层框架，通过物理经验改进基础策略与编程智能体之间的协作，在 RoboDojo-Sim 上实现了 50.57% 的成功率和 57.26 的任务得分，比最强基线分别高出 11.22 个百分点和 10.68 分，同时将端到端延迟降低了 80.4%。

summary.en: RoboThink lets an agent think while a policy acts: the agent rewrites instructions and supplies motion feedback trained via agent-labelled DAgger, raising LIBERO success from 0.09 to 0.87 under drift with 55 s and 8k tokens per success.
summary.zh: RoboThink 让智能体负责思考、策略网络负责执行：智能体通过指令通道改写任务指令、通过反馈通道给动作反馈，借助 agent-labelled DAgger 训练；在 LIBERO 上把恒定漂移下的成功率从 0.09 提到 0.87，在 RoboTwin 2.0 双臂任务上从 0.12 提到 0.74，单个成功仅需 55 秒和 8k tokens。

summary.en: RMR-VLA introduces Recurrent Memory Reasoning to connect memory and action, achieving 66.46% on RoboMME and 90.08% on LIBERO-Mem, doubling success over baselines.
summary.zh: RMR-VLA引入了循环记忆推理机制，通过显式推理步骤连接记忆与动作，在RoboMME上取得了66.46%的总体成功率，相比没有循环机制的同类模型成功率翻倍，并在LIBERO-Mem上达到了90.08%。

summary.en: LeadVLA is a structured multimodal policy for robot leading that decouples explicit path reference, pace learning, and residual adaptation, achieving a 39.6% task success rate on LeadBench and zero-shot real-world transfer.
summary.zh: LeadVLA是一种结构化的多模态策略，通过将路线保持为显式路径引用、学习路线进展的速度以及局部适应性，实现了对指定跟随者的自适应机器人引导，在LeadBench上取得了39.6%的最高任务成功率，并能零样本迁移到真实世界。

summary.en: RoboAda adapts frozen robot policies to unseen physical shifts at test time by inferring motion dynamics and correcting execution commands without changing the original plan, more than doubling average success from 27.8% to 62.9% on LIBERO.
summary.zh: RoboAda通过在测试时推断机器人的动力学变化来修正执行指令，从而在不改变原有策略和计划的前提下适应不可见的物理变化。在LIBERO和RoboTwin 2.0的测试中，它将平均成功率从27.8%提升至62.9%，并在无变化时保持了原有性能。

summary.en: Innata-0 is a native embodied world system co-designing Innata-0-WAM, a tri-tower Mixture-of-Transformers for understanding, prediction and action, with Innata-0-Agent for long-horizon memory, verification and recovery; evaluations show strong embodied understanding, world prediction and manipulation.
summary.zh: Innata-0 原生具身世界系统由 Innata-0-WAM 与 Innata-0-Agent 协同设计：前者用三塔 Mixture-of-Transformers 统一理解、预测与动作生成，后者靠记忆、验证与恢复支持长程执行，评测显示在具身理解、世界预测与机器人操作上表现强劲。

summary.en: A robust lateral string stability framework is developed to study error propagation and achieve downstream error attenuation in heterogeneous vehicle platoons, validated via simulations.
summary.zh: 开发了一个鲁棒的横向胞曼稳定性框架，用于研究异构车辆编队中的误差传播并实现下游误差衰减。结合弧长反馈线性化与提出的 learn-from-predecessor (LFP) 策略，通过仿真验证了其在车辆异构性和局部扰动下的有效性。

summary.en: SEER, a framework that aggregates multi-robot observations into a shared latent world model for representation-space collaboration, consistently improving navigation performance for vision-language navigation agents.
summary.zh: 引入了Shared Environment Encoding and Retrieval框架，通过将多机器人局部观察聚合为共享潜在世界模型，实现了表征空间的协作与去中心化决策，实验表明其持续提升了视觉语言导航代理的导航性能。

summary.en: MorphHOI enables a single physics-based policy to support cooperative human-object interaction across heterogeneous embodiments and tasks, achieving up to 96.7% success on seen embodiments.
summary.zh: MorphHOI是一个去中心化框架，通过规范化身体接口和具身条件Transformer，使单一物理策略能够支持异构具身、团队组成和交互技能间的协作，在已知具身上实现了高达96.7%的成功率。

summary.en: VOPD projects sparse verifier preferences onto the teacher's implicit-reward direction and Rao-Blackwellizes them over the vocabulary for dense verifier-grounded supervision, improving final performance and learning efficiency over vanilla OPD and other on-policy distillation baselines on eight math reasoning benchmarks.
summary.zh: VOPD 将稀疏的验证器奖励投影到教师的隐式奖励方向上，并在整个词表上做 Rao-Blackwell 化，得到稠密的、基于验证器的监督信号，在八项数学推理基准上相比 vanilla OPD 与其他 on-policy distillation 基线同时提升最终性能与学习效率。

summary.en: OVOGO decouples offline value learning from on-policy optimization for flow-based VLAs using a Return-Anchored Ranking Critic, achieving higher success rates than baselines across multiple simulation and real-robot benchmarks.
summary.zh: OVOGO通过将离线价值学习与生成过程的策略上优化分离，实现了基于流匹配的视觉-语言-动作模型的离线强化学习优化。该方法引入了Return-Anchored Ranking Critic，在RoboTwin 2.0、DexJoCo、LIBERO及真实机器人灵巧操作任务中取得了比对比基线更高的成功率。

summary.en: This paper systematically studies how scaling egocentric human data affects VLA and WAM pretraining, highlighting key factors for effective transfer and comparing their scaling behaviors.
summary.zh: 本研究系统评估了第一人称视角数据对机器人VLA和WAM预训练的影响，发现数据多样性和对齐是关键，数据规模扩大对末端执行器平移预测的提升大于精细手指动作，且在数据增加时VLA模型表现出更大增益。

summary.en: DexDuet learns contact-preserving bimanual dexterity from a single human demonstration using interaction rewards and a coordinated policy, improving object-tracking ADD-AUC by 11 to 41 points across four benchmarks.
summary.zh: DexDuet框架通过单个人类示范学习保持接触的双手灵巧操作，利用两个交互奖励和协同策略分解来实现精确模仿。在三个模拟器和五个机器人形态的四个基准测试中，该方法将物体追踪ADD-AUC较基线提升了11到41点，并在122次对比中更好地保持了人类接触。

summary.en: An end-to-end autonomous driving framework combining data curation, imitation learning, and RL, using perception-guided trajectory filtering for safe closed-loop performance.
summary.zh: 开发了一个端到端自动驾驶模型框架，结合了数据筛选、高清地图自动标注、模仿学习和基于模拟的强化学习，并通过感知引导的轨迹筛选方法确保了闭环安全性。

orgs.name: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST)

summary.en: DelayOPSD trains an asynchronous policy to imitate a synchronous teacher on its own rollouts, improving success from 70.4% to 78.7% under a 10-step delay on SmolVLA and outperforming compared methods across benchmarks and real-world robots.
summary.zh: DelayOPSD通过让异步策略在自身轨迹上模仿同步教师，解决了由观察延迟导致的性能下降问题；在LIBERO和Kinetix任务中取得了最高平均成功率，在10步延迟下将SmolVLA成功率从70.4%提升至78.7%，在真实机器人上从46%提升至62%。

summary.en: RoboInF is a benchmark evaluating instruction fidelity in robotic manipulation, supported by the RoboInF-4K dataset of 4,242 demonstrations. Evaluations reveal a gap between task completion and faithful execution across leading models.
summary.zh: RoboInF是一个专注于具身操作中指令保真度的基准测试，通过固定初始场景和机器人状态，评估策略随指令变化调整行为的可靠性。随附的RoboInF-4K数据集包含4242个专家演示，对主流策略和智能体的评估表明任务完成度与忠实执行之间存在显著差距。

orgs.name: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

summary.en: VeriTouch is a framework for generating and verifying synthetic visuo-tactile trajectories to improve robot policy learning, combining a joint world model, a multimodal verifier, and an inverse dynamics model.
summary.zh: VeriTouch是一个用于生成和验证合成视触觉轨迹的框架，通过VeriGen联合生成高保真双视角视频和真实的触觉序列，利用VeriEval多模态验证器过滤不可靠序列，并通过VeriIDM提取动作，实验证明合成数据有效提升了五项真实世界任务中的机器人策略性能。

orgs.name: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

summary.en: ViDiHand2 reformulates VDM-based hand depth estimation as geometric constraint solving via Fine-Grained Geometric Lifting, Clip-Level Ray Fitting and Confidence-Gated Fusion, cutting in-the-wild joint error by 42% and detection failures by 8.82x at 57 FPS.
summary.zh: ViDiHand2 把基于视频扩散模型的单手深度估计从直接回归改为几何约束求解，用 Fine-Grained Geometric Lifting、Clip-Level Ray Fitting 和 Confidence-Gated Fusion 恢复遮挡下的米制 3D 手部运动，在 7 个公开数据集上优于 18 个基线，野外绝对关节误差降低 42%、检测失败减少 8.82 倍，运行速度 57 FPS。

orgs.name: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)

summary.en: GeoMerge-OPD combines response-space regularization, parameter merging, and on-policy distillation to integrate heterogeneous robotic skills in VLA models, outperforming baselines on SIMPLE and LIBERO benchmarks.
summary.zh: GeoMerge-OPD方法通过结合响应空间正则化、参数合并与在线蒸馏，解决了视觉-语言-动作模型中多异构技能整合时的动作漂移问题，在SIMPLE基准的具身人形任务和LIBERO中展现了强大的平衡技能整合能力。

orgs.name: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications

summary.en: Loom attention interweaves vertical attention over prior head outputs via normalized gated linear attention with horizontal token attention, yielding LoomFormer; with only ~2% extra FLOPs, LoomPythia-2.8B reaches ~1.6x mHC-Pythia-2.8B's downstream gain and matches Pythia-12B zero-shot.
summary.zh: Loom attention 通过垂直注意力对前序 head 输出做归一化门控线性注意力，并与水平 token 注意力交织，实现逐 token 动态重连电路，构成 LoomFormer 双流架构；在 300B token、仅增约 2% FLOPs 下，LoomPythia-2.8B 下游增益约为 mHC-Pythia-2.8B 的 1.6 倍，0-shot 追平 Pythia-12B。

summary.en: ABI to learn multi-horizon action-chunk representations without rewards, guiding target policies at test time to surpass zero-shot RL baselines across 65 tasks.
summary.zh: Actor-Free Behavior-Induced Representations（ABI）方法，通过无奖励的后继预测学习多视界动作块表示，在测试时引导目标策略提升零样本泛化能力，在65个运动、导航和操作任务中超越了现有的零样本RL基线。

summary.en: SWEEP-Bench, a simulation benchmark with 80 conveyor-belt manipulation tasks, evaluates embodied policies across varying speeds, revealing that models often fail by outputting actions suited to average demonstration speeds rather than actual ones.
summary.zh: SWEEP-Bench是一个包含80个传送带操作任务的仿真基准，用于评估具身策略在不同物体运动速度下的表现。通过对8个vision-language-action和world-action模型的测试发现，大多数模型的成功率在中等速度时达到峰值，且倾向于产生适应平均示范速度而不是实际速度的动作，而引入过去帧或速度输入可以显著提升性能。

summary.en: WeMM-Ecom spans 0.8B to 35B-A3B multimodal LLMs, using two-stage continued pre-training with rising e-commerce data and hybrid-thinking post-training of on-policy distillation plus RL, beating same-size Qwen3.5 and larger flagships on 28 e-commerce and 64 general benchmarks.
summary.zh: WeMM-Ecom 构建 0.8B 到 35B-A3B 的多模态大模型系列，先以两阶段持续预训练逐步提升电商数据占比，再用 on-policy 蒸馏与强化学习混合后训练，在 28 项电商与 64 项通用基准上优于 Qwen3.5 同规模模型及更大开源旗舰。

summary.en: LiveAudio converts a bidirectional video-to-audio diffusion model into a streaming generator via progressive causal fine-tuning and distillation, generating audio block by block; on VGGSound it beats streaming baselines and surpasses its source model in synchronization, running at 0.79 RTF and 143 ms first-frame latency on one A100.
summary.zh: LiveAudio 将双向视频到音频扩散模型经渐进式因果微调与蒸馏转为流式生成器，逐块生成仅依赖已播放视频的音频；在 VGGSound 上音频质量与时同步优于现有流式模型，同步性超过原双向模型，单张 A100 实时因子 0.79、首帧延迟 143 ms。

orgs.name: University of the Chinese Academy of Sciences

summary.en: GameDojo benchmarks real-time interactive agents on 120 boss encounters across 20 games, with coding agents reconstructing environments and yielding 600 hours of trajectories; GameDojo-4B trained on this data reaches frontier-level, strongest real-time performance.
summary.zh: GameDojo 是覆盖 20 款游戏、120 场 boss 战的实时交互游戏基准，由 coding agents 重建环境并生成 600 小时轨迹；前沿模型实时表现明显不足，用该数据训练的 GameDojo-4B 达到前沿水平且实时表现最强。

orgs.name: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)
Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences

summary.en: HIVE-Bench evaluates 20 encoders from 7 families with one shared flow-matching policy on 24 egocentric bimanual tasks, finding dense patch tokens essential and an inverse-dynamics readout of commanded motion the strongest pre-training predictor.
summary.zh: HIVE-Bench 用同一套 flow-matching 策略在 24 个第一人称双臂任务上评估 7 个家族共 20 个编码器，发现保留稠密 patch token 至关重要，把单视角取平均会损失大部分成功率；用指令运动做逆动力学读出是训练前最强的预测指标，识别、深度、对应关系等指标迁移并不可靠。

orgs.name: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University

summary.en: MakeSense is a multimodal fusion framework that preserves sensor-specific evidence and reduces negative fusion, improving localization, detection, pose transfer, and command prediction across five datasets.
summary.zh: MakeSense是一个多模态融合框架，通过私有流保留传感器特定证据并通过共享瓶颈标记组合信息，有效减少了多模态融合中的负面融合现象，并在MM-Fi、MMAUD、V2X-Real、RELI11D和Humanoid-Everyday等五个数据集上提升了定位、3D检测、位姿传输和命令预测性能。

summary.en: DyLoMo-DiT reuses parameters via weight-shared loops over middle layers plus sparse experts and noise-level-dependent pass counts; it cuts FID 11-24% vs DiT and 36-56% vs DiT-MoE, and beats FLUX.1 on GenEval (0.714 vs 0.673) with 1.05B active parameters.
summary.zh: DyLoMo-DiT 复用参数而非新增参数：权重共享循环重复施加中间层，稀疏专家按 token 分配容量，并按噪声水平动态调整循环次数。在 ImageNet 256×256 上，同参数与计算预算下 FID 相比 DiT 降 11–24%、相比 DiT-MoE 降 36–56%；文生图 GenEval 得分 0.714 超过 FLUX.1 的 0.673，活跃参数仅 1.05B（对比 12B）。

summary.en: Introduced AGV-MAPF_R-CTC and the Lazy-CPBS algorithm to bridge continuous-time MAPF and industrial AGV fleet coordination, significantly reducing search overhead and offering robust runtime trade-offs.
summary.zh: 将连续时间多智能体路径规划应用于工业自动导引车车队协同的新方法 AGV-MAPF_R-CTC，并设计了 Lazy-CPBS 算法，在工业布局的实验中显著降低了搜索开销并提供了最稳健的运行时间权衡。

summary.en: TabAct casts visual imitation as numerical prediction using frozen tabular foundation models for in-context robot control, outperforming baselines on LIBERO and Meta-World with few demonstrations.
summary.zh: TabAct 将视觉模仿转化为数值预测任务，利用冻结的表格基础模型 TabICLv2 实现上下文机器人学习，无需针对目标任务进行微调。在 LIBERO 和 Meta-World 任务中，该方法仅凭单条示范就超越了最强基线，成功率分别高出 20.9 和 5.8 个百分点，且增加示范可进一步提升性能。

summary.en: Native LAM reuses one pretrained video diffusion transformer as both IDM and FDM, bridging them with learnable dynamics registers trained on motion-only counterfactual pairs to distill compact latent actions; PAWlicy with a 3.8B model hits 93.6% success on RoboTwin 2.0.
summary.zh: Native LAM 将预训练视频扩散 Transformer 同时用作 IDM 和 FDM，仅靠可学习 dynamics registers 做因果桥接，在反事实时序对上训练以提取紧凑隐动作；其在 LARY 上超越现有 LAM，基于 3.8B 模型的 PAWlicy 在 RoboTwin 2.0 取得 93.6% 平均成功率。

summary.en: GlanceNav achieves efficient vision-and-language navigation with constant per-step cost using streaming memory and counterfactual rewind, reaching 71.9% and 73.6% success rates on R2R-CE and RxR-CE val-unseen.
summary.zh: GlanceNav通过流式混合MLLM架构与反事实回溯强化学习，实现恒定单步计算开销的视觉语言导航。该4B模型在R2R-CE和RxR-CE验证集上分别达到71.9%和73.6%的成功率，其中在R2R-CE上比最强先前单RGB方法提升9.1个百分点，单步耗时104毫秒。

summary.en: DexLatentWorld introduces a 3D cross-embodiment latent action world model for zero-shot robotic manipulation, achieving 90%, 92%, and 60% success on reaching, grasping, and placing, outperforming DexWM.
summary.zh: DexLatentWorld通过从人类操作点云数据中学习连续动作表示，构建了跨具身的3D潜在动作世界模型，实现了对未见机器人具身的零样本迁移。在任务无关适配后，reaching、grasping和placing成功率分别达到90%、92%和60%，相比DexWM的72%、58%和28%显著提升，并在真实世界未见灵巧手上实现86%的成功率。

summary.en: CUA-SEE is a closed-loop evaluation environment that co-evolves tasks and executable verifiers from rollout evidence, expanding benchmark scope and diagnostic resolution for computer-use agents.
summary.zh: CUA-SEE 构建闭环评估环境，从 rollout 证据共同演化任务与可执行验证器，分开推进基准扩展、诊断探针与验证器精度，在多智能体多轮中生成可测难题。

orgs.name: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

summary.en: Foresight Forcing (F²) distills patch-wise 3D feature differences between current and future observations into spatial transition queries for action generation, reaching 95.01% success on RoboTwin2.0 Full and 85.8% mean score on six real-world tasks.
summary.zh: Foresight Forcing (F²) 利用冻结的 3D 基础模型提取当前与未来观测的 patch 级特征差，作为稠密监督蒸馏出空间转移查询，结合语言指令与本体状态生成动作；在 RoboTwin2.0 Full 上平均成功率 95.01%，六个真实任务平均得分 85.8%。

orgs.name: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
The University of Science and Technology of China

summary.en: TT-RSI is a label-free test-time framework that re-solves questions with full prior solutions (In-Context RSI) and distills refinements into weights (In-Weight RSI). It beats the base model by +13.89% and the strongest self-consistency method by +4.79%.
summary.zh: TT-RSI 是一个无需标签的测试时框架，通过 In-Context RSI 反复参考先前完整解答重解问题、In-Weight RSI 将逐步改进蒸馏进模型权重，实现推理计算累积与纠错；平均准确率较基座模型提升 +13.89%，在同等测试时算力预算下比最强自一致性方法高 +4.79%。

summary.en: WorldLeague benchmarks AI systems on 60 simulated robot tasks via trajectory-based progress and success; Claude Fable 5.2 completes 13 goals and leads with a mean Interactive Score of 28.58/100.
summary.zh: WorldLeague 基准用 60 个模拟机器人任务，通过机器人轨迹衡量系统向物理目标推进的程度与成功率，比较 13 个系统；Claude Fable 5.2 完成 13 个目标，平均 Interactive Score 最高，为 28.58/100。

summary.en: Robo-MOPD consolidates domain specialists into a single planner via multi-teacher on-policy distillation, achieving 58.9% average success on LIBERO-PRO and RoboCasa365, outperforming all baselines.
summary.zh: Robo-MOPD通过多教师在线策略蒸馏将多个领域专家的知识整合进单个学生规划器中，在仿真闭环交互中进行Token级监督。实验表明，单个9B的Robo-MOPD规划器在LIBERO-PRO和RoboCasa365上分别取得了72.9%和44.8%的成功率，平均成功率达到58.9%，超越了所有对比基线。

orgs.name: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

summary.en: RoboUniverse-10K builds 10,807 resettable, verifiable physics environments from real videos via automated Real2Sim, plus a 500-task zero-shot benchmark where frontier models hit 85.8% versus 2.6-10.0% for open baselines; fine-tuning Qwen3.6-35B-A3B lifts success from 0.8% to 21.2%.
summary.zh: RoboUniverse-10K 通过自动化 Real2Sim 与质检流程从真实视频构建 10,807 个可交互、可重置、可验证的物理环境，并留出 500 个任务组成 RoboUniverse-Verified 零样本基准；11 个模型评测中前沿模型成功率 85.8%，开源基线仅 2.6%–10.0%；再用约 17K 多轮轨迹微调 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 得到 RoboUniverse-35B-A3B，零样本成功率从 0.8% 提升到 21.2%。

summary.en: ReWeave jointly optimizes an embodied harness and task topology from interaction with frozen policies, improving success from 89.00% to 98.75% on LIBERO-PRO and 25.50% to 58.25% on RoboDojo.
summary.zh: ReWeave 在保持策略和感知冻结的情况下，通过交互联合优化智能体外设与物理任务拓扑，将 LIBERO-PRO 上的成功率从 89.00% 提升至 98.75%，RoboDojo 上的成功率从 25.50% 提升至 58.25%。

summary.en: Wrist Video Policy introduces a closed-loop manipulation framework using video prediction and geometric estimation, achieving over 50% success rate in zero-shot OOD evaluations across multiple robot embodiments.
summary.zh: Wrist Video Policy通过视频预测和几何估计学习机械臂操作，实现了跨具身的通用控制。该方法在零样本分布外评估中取得了超过50%的成功率，并可直接泛化至Franka Panda、PiPER-X和Galaxea R1 Pro等不同机器人。

summary.en: LoopRes lets looped layers attend to earlier loops with trainable loop-aware keys and a residual window W; on 6 pretrained LLMs and 9 benchmarks it beats SFT by 29.1% on Qwen3-1.7B-Base at 2x compute and scales better.
summary.zh: LoopRes 通过让循环层关注此前各循环输出并引入可训练循环感知 key、限制残差窗口 W，将循环式微调用于预训练 LLM；在 6 个模型、9 个基准上，2 倍计算下 Qwen3-1.7B-Base 较 SFT 提升 29.1%，超过最强基线增益两倍，且在 30B 以内及三个模型家族上稳定，测试时扩展更优。

summary.en: Real2Worlds2Real is an agentic framework that builds faithful digital twins and diverse executable digital cousins from limited observations, then orchestrates data generation, policy learning, and refinement; more world diversity and interaction data improve fidelity and real-world transfer, while skill reuse boosts world-building efficiency.
summary.zh: Real2Worlds2Real 用智能体框架把有限的视觉观测扩成可执行的数字孪生与多样化数字表亲，并据此自动生成数据、训练和精修策略；世界多样性和交互数据量增加带来更高保真度与真实迁移成功率，技能复用还提升建世界效率。

summary.en: We introduce RUIBench and RUIKit to study robot-use interfaces, showing that interface design can shift an agent's success rate from 45% to 81% in simulation.
summary.zh: 推出了包含30个操作任务的RUIBench和统一框架RUIKit，用于系统研究机器人使用接口（RUI）对具身智能体可靠性的影响。仿真实验表明，仅改变RUI就能将前沿智能体的成功率从45%提升至81%，微调4B模型的成功率从13%提升至47%。

summary.en: TideSand multiplexes sandbox resources for LLM agents via agent-aware scheduling, speculative swapping, and selective rollback, achieving 3.8-10x higher throughput than strict reservation and cutting AlgoTune evaluation error by 19x.
summary.zh: TideSand 通过 agent-aware scheduling、speculative swapping 和 selective rollback 三项技术，在工具调用层面调度并复用沙箱资源；在 AlgoTune、Terminal-Bench 4.0 和 Terminal-Bench Science 的六个模型-负载组合上，其吞吐比 strict reservation 高 3.8-10x，保真度比 overcommit 基线高 7-44%，并使 AlgoTune 的评测误差降低 19x。

orgs.name: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

summary.en: WeaveVLA enhances VLA action generation by explicitly modeling task-relevant 3D relative relations and maintaining relational context, achieving over 98% average success on LIBERO and outperforming baselines on complex benchmarks.
summary.zh: WeaveVLA通过显式建模任务相关的3D相对关系和维护关系上下文来增强VLA动作生成，在LIBERO上实现了超过98%的平均成功率，并在LIBERO-Plus和真实世界任务中显著超越基线。

summary.en: Attention Latent Feedback lets each sublayer attend to deeper layers' outputs at the previous position, lowering held-out loss by 0.022-0.024 nats at ~1.1% decoding FLOP overhead and lifting MoE-4.0B average accuracy from 45.1% to 47.0%.
summary.zh: Attention Latent Feedback (ALF) 让每个子层关注前一个位置更深层的输出，训练时展开为两遍并行计算、解码仍为单遍；在最多 4.0B 参数的 MoE 模型上使 held-out loss 比标准残差降低 0.022–0.024 nats，解码 FLOP 开销约 1.1%，MoE-4.0B 在十七个下游基准上平均准确率从 45.1% 提升到 47.0%。

orgs.name: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
The Chinese University of Hong Kong

summary.en: EmboEagle is a closed-loop agentic framework for long-horizon robotic manipulation that unifies WAM control, latent-space adaptive supervision, and memory-guided recovery, achieving 91.3% success on RMBench while cutting VLM calls by 74.2%.
summary.zh: EmboEagle是一个用于长序列机器人操作的闭环智能体框架，它统一了子任务条件下的世界动作模型控制、潜在空间自适应监督和记忆引导的几何恢复。在RMBench和LIBERO-Mem上，该方法取得了91.3%和90.6%的平均成功率，分别比最强的基线高出8.0和9.8个百分点，同时将VLM调用次数减少了74.2%。

summary.en: VITA-WAM achieves real-time robot control via manifold-aligned world-action modeling, outperforming FastWAM by 21.47 pp on LIBERO-Plus with a single ODE step while achieving a 2.10x speedup.
summary.zh: VITA-WAM通过流形对齐的世界-动作建模方法实现了实时机器人控制，采用VITA流匹配直接将潜空间观测表征转换为潜空间动作。在LIBERO-Plus和LIBERO任务中，该方法仅需单步ODE即可分别超越10步的FastWAM达21.47个百分点和1.65个百分点，同时推理延迟降低至55.67毫秒，实现了2.10倍的加速。

summary.en: Embo-Harness systematically studies frontier multimodal models as closed-loop robot policies, distilling six findings; it reaches 83.3% success on RoboLab-120, beating the best baseline by 26.2 points, and solves 15 of 20 zero-shot real-world trials.
summary.zh: Embo-Harness 系统研究前沿多模态模型直接作为机器人策略的闭环框架，梳理提示、规划、动作执行与工具使用四个环节并总结六条经验，在 RoboLab-120 上取得 83.3% 成功率，超最强基线 26.2 个百分点，真实世界四项操作任务零样本 20 次试验成功 15 次。

summary.en: ACAP organizes one robot as a team of persistent coding agents with a hyper-agent coordinating tasks and dependencies, cutting task-balanced time cost by 28.2% versus a single-agent Direct Policy across 72 real-world rollouts.
summary.zh: ACAP 将单台机器人组织为多个持久编码智能体组成的小队，用 hyper-agent 分配任务并协调依赖，实现异步推理与执行；在 25 种任务/平台设置的 72 次真实 rollout 中，任务均衡时间成本比单智能体 Direct Policy 降低 28.2%。

orgs.name: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology

summary.en: Integral turns a pretrained VLM into a unified multimodal model: Abstraction Fusion builds shared visual tokens from a frozen encoder's hierarchy, and Block-wise MoT adds a lightweight generative stream at block boundaries, preserving understanding while enabling strong generation; shared representations beat separate ones.
summary.zh: Integral 将预训练视觉语言模型转为统一多模态模型：Abstraction Fusion 聚合冻结视觉编码器的层级表征构建共享视觉 token，Block-wise MoT 在块边界接入轻量生成流；在保持理解能力的同时实现强图像生成，共享视觉表征比独立表征显著提升生成学习。

summary.en: MoOP prunes reasoning driving VLAs by fusing reasoning and trajectory importance ranks for VLM pruning and aggregating stepwise importance to select expert MLP channels; at 24.0% parameter reduction it matches or slightly beats strongest baselines, retains 94.0% LingoQA, and at 39.4% reduction delivers 1.37x speedup and 36.6% lower peak memory.
summary.zh: MoOP 面向自动驾驶推理 VLA 的结构化剪枝，融合推理与轨迹两个目标的重要性排序来剪 VLM，并按去噪步聚合重要性以固定选择 action expert 的 MLP 通道；在 Alpamayo-1.5-10B 上以 24.0% 参数量削减取得与最强基线相当或略优的驾驶表现，保留 94.0% 的 LingoQA 分数，39.4% 削减时端到端推理加速 1.37x、峰值内存降低 36.6%。
