summary.en: Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation frames visual creation as Pixel as Code, pairing discrete visual tokens with explicit programs via a shared generation-rendering interface; its tokenizer lifts reconstruction PSNR from 26.08 to 29.57 dB and GenEval2 Soft-TIFA GM from 31.71 to 52.56.
summary.zh: Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation 以 Pixel as Code 为框架，用离散视觉 token 表示栅格图像、用显式程序表示结构化产物，并统一生成与渲染接口；配套 tokenizer 在约178K图像上把重建 PSNR 从 Emu3.5 IBQ 的 26.08 提升至 29.57 dB，编码快 7.13 倍、解码快 10.93 倍，GenEval2 Soft-TIFA GM 从 31.71 升至 52.56。

summary.en: Hi3R-VLA is a 3D policy that grounds heterogeneous modalities in explicit 3D geometry using semantic fusion and 3D-RoPE action attention, achieving state-of-the-art performance across diverse manipulation benchmarks with under 250M parameters.
summary.zh: Hi3R-VLA是一个将视觉、语言和动作基于3D几何进行落地的具身策略模型，通过将空间对齐的视觉特征和语言条件注入点云并利用3D-RoPE增强的动作到点注意力机制进行精准控制；在少于2.5亿可训练参数下，在RoboCasa、RLBench、RoboTwin2、DexJoCo和DexSuite等多个模拟与真实机器人任务中取得了最先进的性能。

summary.en: We propose DRIFT for efficient one-phase visual RL using frozen pretrained vision encoders, achieving a 58.8% relative improvement in real-world success rate over two-phase distillation across three manipulation tasks.
summary.zh: DRIFT通过冻结预训练视觉编码器实现高效的单阶段视觉强化学习，在三个操作任务中，其实际平均成功率比两阶段蒸馏法相对提升了58.8%。

summary.en: Vernier computes a leaderboard's resolution from its published per-dataset scores: GIFT-Eval resolves 6.8 rank places with neighbors 0.91 apart, and shortening history raised error for three of four open models, two by 15%.
summary.zh: Vernier 从排行榜已公开的逐数据集分数计算其分辨率：GIFT-Eval 仅能分辨 6.8 个名次、相邻条目仅差 0.91，前十里可分辨步数不足两步；BOOM 因 2,554 条序列而能分辨前十；缩短历史长度使四个开源模型中三个误差上升，两个升 15%。

summary.en: FoveaWAM uses a role-aware 4D world-action model to achieve dynamic manipulation, reaching an 82.1% success rate on OnTimeBench, which is 20.8 points above the strongest baseline.
summary.zh: FoveaWAM通过根据角色分配精度的原生4D世界-动作模型来处理动态操作，将目标位姿建模为公制SE(3)轨迹，将周围环境建模为稀疏3D流。在OnTimeBench上达到82.1%的成功率，比最强基线高20.8个百分点，且推理速度比视频世界-动作基线快约10倍。

summary.en: LeanWAM transfers video priors from a frozen video generator to a lightweight policy via two-stage training, achieving robust control that outperforms strong baselines on LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0 with a 12.3--41.5x faster action prediction speed.
summary.zh: LeanWAM通过将冻结视频生成器的视频先验通过两阶段训练蒸馏到轻量级策略中，实现了高效且鲁棒的具身控制。它将未来表征压缩为32个预测token，在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和RoboTwin 2.0上超越了强视觉-语言-动作和世界模型基线，动作预测速度达25.1毫秒，比代表性世界模型快12.3到41.5倍。

summary.en: G0.7 scales Fast-WAM to five-minute context and large robot teleoperation plus human ego video pretraining; Fast mode decodes a 16-step action chunk in 60 ms (7.6x faster than IDM), scoring 70.8 across five simulation suites and 48%/54% zero-shot pick-and-place success.
summary.zh: G0.7 将 Fast-WAM 的上下文窗口从单帧观测扩展到最多五分钟历史，并在大规模机器人遥操作与人类自我中心视频上扩大预训练；Fast 模式每 16 步动作块仅需 60ms（较 IDM 快 7.6 倍），五项仿真基准平均 70.8 分，Galaxea R1 Pro 与 R1 Lite 零样本抓放成功率 48% 与 54%。

summary.en: Ada-BFM is a post-training framework that adapts pretrained behavior foundation models for humanoid scene interaction using lightweight adapters, achieving efficient learning and preserving general control capabilities in simulation and real-world experiments.
summary.zh: Ada-BFM是一个用于人型机器人场景交互的后训练框架，通过在预训练的行为基础模型中加入轻量级适配器，实现了对地形和物体交互任务的高效适应，并在仿真和真实世界实验中验证了其能加速学习并保留通用控制能力。

summary.en: RESET uses a single real demonstration to rebuild a verifiable world and self-improve skills, achieving a 97% average success rate in simulation and an 80% success rate across 4 real robots.
summary.zh: RESET通过单次真实演示重建可验证的物理世界并自我改进技能，在仿真中达成97%的平均成功率，并在真实机器人实验中4种机器人共280次试验中取得80%的成功率。

summary.en: DUALingo introduces a large-scale dataset for bimanual 3D affordance grounding, featuring 271K tasks on 71K objects generated via automated foundation models. Models trained on it achieved a threefold aIoU improvement over the zero-shot baseline from 10.3 to 37.8.
summary.zh: 推出了DUALingo这一大规模双手指令引导的3D物体可供性定位数据集，包含71K个物体上的271K个任务，通过全自动开源基础模型管道生成。基于该数据集训练的模型在aIoU上比零样本基线提升了三倍以上，从10.3提高到37.8。

summary.en: VLG-Drive fuses frozen VLM and geometric features via a geometry-anchored residual to train a lightweight driving planner, achieving top performance on NavHard with 31.78 EPDMS and outperforming baselines in closed-loop HUGSIM scenarios.
summary.zh: VLG-Drive通过几何锚定残差将冻结的视觉语言模型与几何基础模型特征进行逐点融合，训练轻量级规划器预测自车轨迹。该方法在NavHard扰动初始状态下取得了31.78 EPDMS的最高成绩，并在420个HUGSIM闭环驾驶场景中优于所有对比规划器。

summary.en: Coding4Games benchmarks whether coding agents can iteratively build standalone programs that play 15 modern games from visual input and standard controls; best per-game programs beat the strongest GUI baseline on 13 and tie on one.
summary.zh: Coding4Games 基准测试考察 coding agents 能否通过在沙盒中使用标准玩家接口反复迭代，开发出仅凭视觉观察和标准输入就能自主玩现代游戏的程序；在 15 款游戏中，每款游戏的最佳程序有 13 款得分高于最强的 GUI baseline、1 款持平，人类玩家在 10 款中仍领先。

summary.en: RoboHarness-RL trains VLM-based robot manipulation via multi-turn RL over tool calls, with LiteHarness compressing context; Qwen3.5-9B rises from 31.2% to 44.0% on RoboTwin 2.0 and 57.8% to 73.3% on LIBERO-Pro.
summary.zh: RoboHarness-RL 通过工具调用对 VLM 机器人操作进行多轮强化学习，配合分层记忆的 LiteHarness 压缩上下文，Qwen3.5-9B 在 RoboTwin 2.0 上成功率从 31.2% 升至 44.0%，在 LIBERO-Pro 上从 57.8% 升至 73.3%。

summary.en: Generalized tensor parallelism (GTP) unifies data, tensor, sequence, context parallelism and FSDP, scheduling per-GEMM all-gathers to hide communication and bound memory. It trains a 2T-parameter MoE at 13.0 model EFLOP/s on 12,288 GB300 GPUs with 98% weak-scaling efficiency, and reaches 1.05-1.55x Megatron-FSDP throughput.
summary.zh: GTP 把数据、张量、序列、上下文并行与 FSDP 统一为同一框架，按 GEMM 粒度调度参数 all-gather 以隐藏通信并控制显存；在 12,288 块 GB300 GPU 上训练 2T 参数 MoE 模型达 13.0 model EFLOP/s、98% 弱扩展效率，256–1,024 GPU 上吞吐为 Megatron-FSDP 的 1.05–1.55 倍。

summary.en: LoopDVR reuses Transformer blocks across ViT backbone and decoder layers via representation-dissimilarity-based sharing groups, terminal-layer initialization, and per-layer Loop Adapters; it cuts parameters ~28% at comparable accuracy, with LoopDet-S reaching 50.9 box AP using 7.0M parameters.
summary.zh: LoopDVR 按层间表示差异划分共享组，将 ViT 骨干与 Transformer 解码器中的块跨层复用，并以组末层预训练权重初始化、配合逐层 Loop Adapter 保留深度特有变换，再经表示蒸馏训练；参数减少约 28% 且精度相当，LoopDet-S 以 7.0M 参数取得 50.9 box AP。

summary.en: KeyMemVLA utilizes a subtask-guided key memory framework for long-horizon manipulation, achieving higher average success rates than baselines across multiple benchmarks.
summary.zh: KeyMemVLA通过引入子任务引导的关键内存框架来解决长周期机器人操作中的内存依赖问题。该方法利用两级标注选择关键帧指导内存写入，在RMBench-$M(n)$等多个基准测试中展现出比对比基准更高的平均成功率。

summary.en: ActiveBridge transfers human active priors to robots via egocentric perception-interaction modeling, enabling active viewpoint control for manipulation and outperforming baselines.
summary.zh: ActiveBridge 框架通过自我中心感知与交互建模，将人类的主动先验迁移至机器人，利用单头载相机主动控制视角来获取操作所需视觉信息。实验表明，该方法在主动操作任务上优于基线模型。

summary.en: Ego2Real learns bimanual dexterous manipulation from egocentric visuo-tactile demonstrations using tactile-guided reconstruction and contact-informed reinforcement learning, achieving higher success rates.
summary.zh: Ego2Real是一个利用第一视角视觉触觉示范学习双手灵巧操作的框架，通过触觉引导的手物交互重建和接触感知强化学习，指导拟人化机器人手模仿人类接触行为，实验表明融入触觉监督提高了操作成功率。

summary.en: Duo introduces a spatiotemporal action coordination design for bimanual policies using cross-arm attention, improving success rates on RoboTwin 2.0 and outperforming baseline policies in real-world tasks.
summary.zh: Duo 提出了一种在双臂策略中进行时空动作协调的设计，将每个时间步的双臂分为两个动作并在流匹配期间通过跨臂注意力机制交互；在 RoboTwin 2.0 上，Duo 将 FLOWER 和 $\pi_{0.5}$ 的整体成功率分别提升了 12.55 和 9.02 个百分点，并在真实世界任务中超越了 $\pi_{0.5}$ 的成功率和执行速度。

summary.en: ThinkMorph-SSL turns visual pretext tasks like colorization and denoising into instruction-free interleaved reasoning traces, followed by auto-built demonstration tuning, gaining 11.33 points over the base model across twelve benchmarks.
summary.zh: ThinkMorph-SSL 用图像自监督构建无指令的交错推理轨迹，把上色、去噪等视觉 pretext 任务转成“描述-生成-解读”流程，再做自动演示指令微调，在十二个基准上平均比基座模型高 11.33 个点。

summary.en: SkillHarness is an execution-aware coordination framework integrating a plug-and-play skill library and vision-language guidance for robust long-horizon terrain traversal without retraining locomotion policies.
summary.zh: SkillHarness是一个执行感知的主动式协调框架，通过可插拔的运动技能库和视觉语言引导实现长视距越野导航。它利用感知强化学习减少环境波动敏感性，并通过事件触发推理和执行反馈优化技能组合，在不重新训练底层策略的情况下适应未见地形。

orgs.name: University of Science and Technology of China
University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

summary.en: MoGe-4D unifies geometry and motion prediction via ordered queries of paired allocentric and egocentric dynamic point maps, using a cached context encoder and lightweight query decoder; with the RigIDTrack dataset, it achieves state-of-the-art dense 3D tracking and fast 4D reconstruction.
summary.zh: MoGe-4D 用成对 allocentric/egocentric 动态点图的有序查询统一几何与运动预测，以闭式解求相机位姿并支持深度、动态配准与稠密 3D 跟踪；配合 RigIDTrack 合成数据管线（轨迹存储仅约 15% 开销），在多个基准上取得最优稠密 3D 跟踪，重建性能媲美专用 3D 基础模型且速度显著快于以往 4D 方法。

summary.en: Mancelle-3B uses conditional pretraining with a separate control channel to steer LLMs more strongly and robustly than prompt- and activation-based baselines, resisting counter-steering attacks; Mancelle-400M reproduces this.
summary.zh: 通过将控制通道与词流分离的条件预训练架构训练出 Mancelle-3B，使高层语义特征成为可调控制接口；其在同等开源模型上比 prompt 与激活引导方法控制更强且保持流畅，并能抵御击败这些基线的黑盒与 soft-prompt 反引导攻击，Mancelle-400M 上也复现。

summary.en: RoboClock is a unified benchmark for time-aware robotic manipulation with 60 tasks. Evaluation of over 30 methods shows the best VLA achieves only 8.3% temporal success on easy tasks.
summary.zh: RoboClock是一个统一的时序感知机器人操作基准，包含来自五个应用领域的60个任务，采用三种时序约束和延迟对齐评估协议。对30多种方法的评估显示，表现最好的训练后VLA在简单级别任务上也仅达到8.3%的时序成功率。

orgs.name: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China

summary.en: Boundary-Aware Policy Learning shapes and expands visuomotor policies' handoff boundaries via boundary-explicit training and self-improvement, hitting 98.4% success on RoboTwin 2.0, over 26 points above the strongest baseline, with 41.3% lower API cost and 37.5% less execution time.
summary.zh: Boundary-Aware Policy Learning 通过 Boundary-Explicit Training 在多样起始位姿的接触段上微调视觉运动策略，再用 Boundary-Expanding Self-Improvement 将 handoff boundary 向任务早期扩展；在 RoboTwin 2.0 随机场景达到 98.4% 成功率，比最强基线高 26 个百分点以上，API 成本和执行时间分别降低 41.3% 和 37.5%。

summary.en: PILOT disentangles physical condition evolution from low-level action trajectory generation using motion chain-of-thought guidance, improving success rate, generalization, and data efficiency in robotic manipulation.
summary.zh: PILOT的方法，通过引入运动思维链（motion CoT）将物理条件演化与低层动作轨迹生成解耦，有效提升了世界动作模型在复杂机器人操作任务中的成功率、泛化能力及数据效率。

summary.en: RoboDemo reconciles demonstration intent and execution progress for long-horizon manipulation using dual-cascaded test-time-training, achieving 90.7% success on Imitator Game and 73.3% on real-world tasks.
summary.zh: RoboDemo是一个通过双级联测试时训练协调示范意图与执行进度的长周期操作框架，利用持久示范意图记忆与交互进度记忆实现对执行偏差的自适应调整，在Imitator Game中取得90.7%的成功率，在三个真实世界家居任务中取得73.3%的成功率。

summary.en: EgoLoAF derives humanoid loco-manipulation data directly from egocentric demonstrations without wearable trackers, achieving near-teleoperation performance (73.1 vs. 74.4 Task Progress Score) and a 4.03x efficiency boost.
summary.zh: EgoLoAF利用第一人称示范直接生成人形机器人运动操作训练数据，无需穿戴式动作追踪器或真实机器人遥操作，在四个真实任务中取得了接近遥操作的平均任务进度得分（73.1对比74.4），数据收集效率提升了4.03倍。

summary.en: GOLD-SLAM combines panoramic Gaussian splatting with omnidirectional LiDAR priors for accurate spherical SLAM, improving PSNR by 5.56-9.10 dB and reducing Depth-L1 by 71.9-83.9% over baselines.
summary.zh: GOLD-SLAM系统结合全景高斯泼溅与全向LiDAR深度先验，在球面域进行高精度追踪与建图，平均PSNR比现有全景基线提升5.56至9.10 dB，Depth-L1降低71.9%至83.9%。

summary.en: Any2Act scales robot in-context learning from heterogeneous demonstrations using a unified embodiment-grounded representation and source-routed adapters, achieving 57.5% success on unseen tasks from a single demonstration.
summary.zh: Any2Act通过统一的具身扎根表示和源路由适配器，实现了从异构示范中扩展机器人上下文学习，在单次示范下于未见任务上取得了57.5%的成功率，超越了每项任务微调50次示范的VLA。

orgs.name: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

summary.en: MAGPIE encodes multi-reference image compositions as executable Blender programs, with a coding agent binding instances to references and revising geometry, then trains generators on the proxy rendering; FLUX gains 28.21 points on DreamOmni2.
summary.zh: MAGPIE 将多参考图像生成的目标构图表示为可执行的 Blender 程序，由编码智能体把每个实例与对应参考图绑定，并检查几何和渲染视角、迭代修正程序，再用代理渲染作为视觉计划训练生成器；在 DreamOmni2 和 SconeEval 上同时提升 Qwen 与 FLUX，FLUX 版本在 DreamOmni2 上总体成功率较原骨干提升 28.21 个百分点。

summary.en: ViTacLab provides physically consistent visuo-tactile simulation, benchmarking, and representation learning, reducing force RMSE and achieving high throughput in parallel environments.
summary.zh: ViTacLab 框架通过 ViTacSim、ViTacBench 和 ViTacPolicy 实现了具物理一致性的视触觉仿真、基准测试与表征学习。实验表明，该方法将法向和切向力 RMSE 分别从 2.31 和 1.85 N 降至 0.42 和 0.53 N，在 256 个并行环境中吞吐量达到 2,482.9 FPS。

summary.en: CodeWAM is an end-to-end driving world model integrating executable code for ego dynamics and visual modeling for scene evolution, achieving 93.6 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 navtest, 92.1 EPDMS on v2 navtest, and 50.6 EPDMS on NAVHARD.
summary.zh: CodeWAM是一种结合可执行代码与视觉模型的端到端自动驾驶世界模型，通过代码表达自车动力学，联合视觉预测场景演化结果。该模型在NAVSIM v1 navtest上取得93.6 PDMS，在v2 navtest上取得92.1 EPDMS，并在NAVHARD上达到50.6 EPDMS。

summary.en: AirLeg is a self-supervised visual-inertial-leg SLAM system that achieves mutual supervision between vision and leg proprioception, attaining the lowest average error of 0.19 m across 17 GrandTour sequences and 0.6% drift on a quadruped.
summary.zh: AirLeg是一个自监督的视觉-惯性-腿部SLAM系统，通过多传感器束差分调整实现视觉与腿部本体感觉的相互监督。在17个GrandTour序列中实现了最低的平均误差0.19米，并在低成本四足机器人上实现了0.6%的最低漂移。

summary.en: ContinualDrive is a deployment-anchored benchmark for continual updates of driving planners, showing that evaluated training regimes fail to improve closed-loop performance over deployed models on nuPlan.
summary.zh: ContinualDrive是一个部署锚定的多轴基准，用于评估驾驶规划器的持续学习更新。研究发现，在nuPlan上的闭环评估中，现有的持续学习策略均未能超越已部署的模型，凸显了评估方法选择对结果的关键影响。

orgs.name: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

summary.en: PartAgent is a training-free agentic framework for 3D part segmentation that integrates 3D region proposals with multiview 2D semantic cues and applies observation-driven closed-loop refinement; it reaches 68.41 mIoU on PartObjaverse-Tiny-WT, 8.53 points above the strongest competitor.
summary.zh: PartAgent 是免训练的智能体式 3D 部件分割框架，通过结构-语义专家集成融合 3D 区域提议与多视角 2D 语义线索，并用观测驱动的闭环细化选择检查、修复或重组动作；在 PartObjaverse-Tiny-WT 上达 68.41 mIoU，领先最强对比方法 8.53 点，在四个数据集上平均 69.36。

summary.en: MXI-MemICL enables memory-guided in-context robot manipulation for VLA models by leveraging self-retrieved interaction memory, achieving significant success rate gains on RoboCasa365, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-robot tasks.
summary.zh: MXI-MemICL通过自检索交互记忆将具象化演示转化为可复用记忆，实现视觉-语言-动作模型的上下文操作。在RoboCasa365和RoboTwin 2.0上，该方法比基线成功率分别提升了8.2%和14.4%，真实机器人实验表明在未见任务上提升了16.7%。

summary.en: Developed a five-fingered soft-rigid hybrid dexterous hand with 12 active DOFs using linear control, successfully completing 84.8% of human grasp postures and demonstrating superior performance in teleoperated manipulation tasks.
summary.zh: 开发了一种具有12个主动自由度的五指软刚混合灵巧手，结合了结构柔顺性与刚性骨架，利用线性控制实现了软抓握的通用性。实验表明，该手能够完成人类手部33种抓握姿态中的28种（占84.8%），并能高效执行薄形可变形物体抓取等多种远程操作任务。

summary.en: The equal-budget ladder grades multi-agent LLM teams against a single agent, compute-matched majority vote, and pass@n; recursively self-trained groups, which forward split facts, beat pass@n by ~1/3 at 27B, gain 18 points from emergent hubs, and improve for 4-6 generations.
summary.zh: 等算力阶梯（equal-budget ladder），在单智能体、算力对齐多数投票与算力对齐 pass@n 三级上衡量多智能体团队，并定义 Recursive Collective Intelligence（RCI）：无教师、无外部标签，团队用自身输出让下一代同等成本更聪明；转发拆分事实可在 27B 上超 pass@n 约三分之一，同质 27B 智能体自发形成枢纽使准确率提升 18 个百分点，两代无标签训练在 PlanBench、HiddenBench、Hanabi 上连续 4–6 代优于前代。

summary.en: VenusOCR2.0 pairs a SigLIP2 encoder with a Qwen3-0.6B decoder, bounded recursive self-improvement data engine, and atomic OTSL tokens, scoring 96.45 overall and 98.57 formula CDM on OmniDocBenchv1.6; its PTPv2 parallel draft module gives 2.96x lossless single-request speedup on H20.
summary.zh: VenusOCR2.0 以 1B 参数的 SigLIP2 编码器加 Qwen3-0.6B 解码器构建文档解析器，配合有界递归自改进数据引擎与 OTSL 原子 token，在 OmniDocBenchv1.6 上总分 96.45、公式 CDM 98.57，超过 Gemini-3-Pro 的 92.91；并行草稿模块 PTPv2 在 H20 上带来 2.96 倍单请求加速且无损。

summary.en: RoboRecast is an agentic optimization framework that preserves task intent while augmenting demonstrations via simulation feedback, improving policy success on single-arm and bimanual tasks.
summary.zh: RoboRecast是一个基于智能体优化的演示增强框架，通过诊断仿真反馈来联合优化场景和机器人运动，在保持源任务交互意图的同时生成目标环境下的合成数据，并在真实单臂和模拟双臂任务中提升了策略成功率。

summary.en: ReFocus is a progress-guided multi-round RL framework for long-horizon manipulation that alternates between global and local RL to identify bottlenecks and practice them, achieving 97.8% success on LIBERO-Long.
summary.zh: ReFocus是一个长序列机器人操作强化学习框架，通过全局和局部强化学习的交替迭代来识别任务瓶颈并进行针对性练习。在LIBERO-Long和RoboCasa365上分别取得了97.8%和51.3%的成功率，优于基线方法的90.6%和39.3%。

summary.en: BARE enables humanoid robots to perform rapid local evasion from dynamic obstacles while maintaining whole-body stability using human motion priors and reinforcement learning.
summary.zh: BARE 框架通过人体运动先验实现具身机器人的身体感知反射性规避，利用局部身体调整在维持全身稳定性的同时快速躲避动态障碍物，并在仿真和真实实验中验证了其有效性。

summary.en: ICLWorld is an online benchmark spanning computer and robot use, with UIverse unifying 30 environments, 630 demos and 160 tasks; top agents score 82%/76% on computer tasks but only 27%/26% on robot tasks.
summary.zh: ICLWorld 是覆盖电脑操作与机器人操作的在线基准，用 UIverse 把 30 个环境统一为界面，含 630 段演示视频和 160 个任务；Claude Opus 5.5、GPT-6 Astra 在电脑任务成功率 82%/76%，机器人任务仅 27%/26%。

summary.en: DexWAC jointly learns an actor, action-conditioned world model, and bootstrapped critic in one robot pretraining stage; its image-editing world model predicts chunk-endpoint latents and rewards without intermediate frames, reaching 75% real-world success versus π0.5's 45%.
summary.zh: DexWAC 将 actor、动作条件世界模型与 bootstrapped critic 统一在一次机器人预训练中联合学习；世界模型基于图像编辑骨干，直接预测每个动作块终点的视觉隐变量、本体感受、奖励与延续信号，无需生成中间视频帧；在真实任务上平均成功率达 75%，高于 π0.5 的 45%。

summary.en: DiffGR00T introduces an end-to-end differentiable training framework using a learned world model, improving humanoid average task success from 59.2% to 71.7% across four simulation tasks.
summary.zh: DiffGR00T将GR00T N1.7与SONIC结合，利用学习到的动作条件世界模型替代不可微仿真器，实现了端到端的可微训练，将人形机器人在四个HumanoidArena仿真任务上的平均任务成功率从59.2%提升至71.7%。

summary.en: Support2Sim is a Real2Sim system reconstructing physics-ready scenes from a single RGB image, improving source-mask IoU by 21.4 pp and reducing mean object drift to 45.3 mm compared to baselines.
summary.zh: Support2Sim是一个从单张RGB图像重建物理仿真场景的Real2Sim系统，利用支持图、接触引导姿态初始化器和粗到细的精炼器在短时间内实现高源保真度和稳定性。在50个场景的基准测试中，其源掩码IoU比最强基线提升了21.4个百分点，支持实现率达到87.1%，并将平均物体漂移减少至45.3毫米。

summary.en: Qwen-Image-HD adapts Qwen-Image 2.0 to high-resolution synthesis via local training and blockwise autoregressive generation, each 1K tile conditioned on high-res upper/left neighbors and a compressed thumbnail; it outperforms FLUX-3-Image-Klein direct 4K generation on Qwen-Image-Bench with lower training compute and faster inference.
summary.zh: Qwen-Image-HD 通过局部训练与分块自回归生成，将 Qwen-Image 2.0 适配到高分辨率合成，每个 1K 目标块以高分辨率上邻、左邻和压缩历史缩略图为条件，在 Qwen-Image-Bench 4K 上整体优于 FLUX-3-Image-Klein 直接生成，且训练算力更低、推理更快、重复条纹更少。

summary.en: SimPWM uses a parameter-free simulator as a video world model proxy, achieving a robot IoU of 0.75-0.78 and reducing missed pick-ups from 54% to 38% on unseen DROID episodes.
summary.zh: SimPWM利用一个无需训练参数的规则模拟器作为视频世界模型的代理，从首帧渲染机器人的3D模型和物体的3D点。在DROID未见设置的数据集上，该方法使机器人的IoU达到0.75-0.78，且将物体抓取失败率从54%降至38%。

summary.en: A controlled comparison between dense and keypose action representations shows keypose is robust to noisy demonstrations and shifts, while dense often succeeds more with clean demonstrations given proper tuning.
summary.zh: 通过在模拟和真实机器人任务中对比稠密动作表示与关键姿态动作表示，发现关键姿态在嘈杂演示和分布偏移下表现更稳健，但在干净演示下通常逊色或接近稠密动作，且严重依赖执行器的调整。

summary.en: MRBench benchmarks physical necessity reasoning in multi-robot manipulation. MRScissors uses constrained search to achieve 85.4% and 91.2% team-selection accuracy, outperforming baselines by up to 10.4 points.
summary.zh: 推出了用于评估异构多机器人操作中物理必要性推理的基准测试MRBench，并提出了MRScissors方法，通过分离任务需求和物理能力来进行约束搜索。在两个模型主干下，MRScissors实现了85.4%和91.2%的团队选择准确率，比最强基线分别高出10.4和9.5个百分点。

summary.en: Atomic Policy combines vision-language models, PDDL planning, and agentic reasoning to compose manipulation skills, improving task execution and recovery in long-horizon scenarios.
summary.zh: Atomic Policy框架通过视觉语言模型、PDDL求解器与智能体闭环推理，将学习到的操作技能进行组合，实现了复杂长周期任务中的精准控制、状态验证与自适应重规划。

summary.en: SpatialArena benchmarks 52 geometric foundation models across five tasks and 23 datasets (418,929 images) with unified metrics and robust alignment, showing monocular depth saturates on public benchmarks while cross-frame and cross-view consistency drives progress.
summary.zh: SpatialArena 用统一指标和确定性对齐在 5 项任务、23 个数据集共 418,929 张图像上评测 52 个几何基础模型，发现单目深度在公开基准接近饱和，跨帧跨视角一致性才是新进展来源，前馈 3D/4D 模型已媲美单目专家并超越视频深度模型。

summary.en: Residual Guidance (RG) is a training-free method that denoises the re-noised previous chunk without cache under the new prompt and adds the residual to early denoising steps of the next chunk, mitigating context inertia and substantially improving prompt switching in streaming video generation.
summary.zh: Residual Guidance (RG) 是一种免训练方法，通过在缓存外对新 prompt 下的上一 chunk 去噪得到残差并注入下一 chunk 的早期去噪步，缓解流式视频生成中的 context inertia，在单次和多次切换设置下显著提升现有模型的 prompt 切换能力并基本保持画质。

summary.en: DOPER is an RGB-based 6D object pose estimation framework that jointly performs detection, segmentation, and keypoint prediction, achieving state-of-the-art detection AP across multiple datasets while running in real time at 35 Hz.
summary.zh: DOPER是一个基于RGB的6D物体位姿估计框架，通过共享视觉主干网络联合处理检测、分割和关键点预测。该方法利用合成训练、部分真实观测监督及多视图几何约束进行适应，在HANDAL、HOPEv2、HOT3D和T-LESS数据集上取得了最先进的检测平均精度，并在单GB300上以35 Hz的实时速度运行。

summary.en: RLVB rewards agents for continuing while the simulator's exact answer posterior still admits multiple options and committing once evidence suffices, requiring no judge or reward model; it beats base models by 17.1% on average across nine settings and LLM-judge PPO by 9.3% with 1.6x fewer GPU-hours.
summary.zh: RLVB 利用训练时模拟器可算出的答案后验，奖励智能体在后验仍含多个候选时继续探索、证据充分时提交答案，无需评判器或奖励模型；在三个视觉谜题基准的九个设置上平均超过基模型 17.1%，比使用 LLM 评判过程奖励的 PPO 高 9.3% 且省 1.6 倍 GPU 时。

summary.en: Developed a self-sensing compliant anthropomorphic hand for contact-aware shared-control teleoperation, which estimates joint states and forces without external sensors and improves grasp success rates for fragile and heavy objects.
summary.zh: 开发了一种自感应柔顺拟人手，利用肌腱驱动中的串联弹簧和电位计实现无外部传感器的关节状态和力估计，并构建了基于VR的接触感知共享控制框架，提高了脆弱和重型物体的抓取成功率。

summary.en: DynaMimic introduces a physics-informed differentiable world model for humanoid motion tracking, reducing MPJPE by 18.6% over SuperMimic across 60 motions and successfully deploying on a real A3 humanoid.
summary.zh: DynaMimic 引入了一种显式结合共享物理特性的可微分世界模型，通过预测接触扳手和残余广义力来计算下一个状态。在 60 个 LAFAN1 运动中，相比 SuperMimic，该方法将平均关节位置误差（MPJPE）降低了 18.6%，并在真实 A3 人形机器人上实现了多样化技能。

summary.en: SpecEngineeringBench evaluates coding agents on autonomous spec engineering with 100 instances from 78 Python repos; seven agents reach 91.47% Head Pass Rate but only 26.36% Fail-to-Pass and 51.29% function-level localization recall.
summary.zh: SpecEngineeringBench 用 78 个开源 Python 仓库的 100 个实例评测编码 agent 的自主规格工程能力：生成测试套件与执行分析定位缺陷；七个前沿 agent 的 Head Pass Rate 达 91.47%，但 Fail-to-Pass Rate 仅 26.36%，函数级定位召回从文件级 78.11% 降至 51.29%。

summary.en: RoboDojo-Mirror benchmarks five VLA, world-action and agentic policies under mirror conditions, cutting success by 10.8-56.7 points (up to 62.5 on mirrored tabletops), with failures linked to reflected-object phantom targeting.
summary.zh: RoboDojo-Mirror 基准在无镜、单镜、双镜和镜面桌面条件下对比五种 VLA、世界动作模型和 agent 策略，平均成功率下降 10.8–56.7 个百分点，镜面桌面下最多降 62.5 个百分点；几何匹配的非反射面板对照显示 50–88% 的镜面相关失败并无接触，归因于反射物幻影定位与真实物体空间错位。

orgs.name: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)

summary.en: EmbodiSafety benchmarks embodied safety with 1,092 snapshot and 540 trajectory tasks across 844 scenes and six response modes; Claude-Opus-5.5 leads at 56.1% and 61.5% complete decision accuracy, and 40k alignment examples improve Qwen3.5-2B/4B.
summary.zh: EmbodiSafety 构建 844 个视觉场景下的 1092 个快照任务和 540 个轨迹任务，覆盖直接执行、拒绝、澄清、受限执行、自主恢复、人工上报六种响应模式，评估具身模型的风险理解与安全决策；Claude-Opus-5.5 完整决策准确率最高，在快照任务和轨迹任务上分别达到 56.1% 和 61.5%，用 4 万条对齐数据监督训练可提升 Qwen3.5-2B/4B 的表现。

summary.en: Investigating how much RL-acquired knowledge persists in rollouts, maximum likelihood replay that fits archived rollouts in generation order without distinguishing correct responses matches online RL performance.
summary.zh: 研究RL后训练产生的rollout中保留多少知识，发现直接用最大似然拟合归档rollout（maximum likelihood replay），不区分对错、按生成顺序回放，即可复现在线RL的性能，单次更新即可追踪完整学习曲线。

summary.en: We introduce beta-Data and a midtraining approach using adversarial teleoperation and relabeling, achieving better low-level behavior coverage, zero-shot generalization, and online fine-tuning success across simulation and three real-robot platforms.
summary.zh: 引入β-Data数据集和midtraining方法，通过对抗性遥操作和自然语言轨迹重新打标，使机器人策略在模拟器及三个真实机器人平台上展现出更好的低层行为覆盖、零样本泛化能力以及更高的在线微调成功率。

summary.en: IWAM conditions action policies on features from a single video-backbone forward pass, learning a bidirectional flow map to amortize future generation and substantially reduce inference cost while retaining WAM generalization.
summary.zh: iWAM 不生成完整未来帧，而是将训练未来反演为潜噪声，学习双向流映射摊销生成计算，仅用一次视频骨干前向传播为动作策略提供条件；在仿真与真实机器人上保持 WAM 泛化优势并大幅降低推理成本。

orgs.name: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China

summary.en: ROAM-Bench evaluates embodied active spatial intelligence under robot motion and collision constraints with 250 tasks across 27 indoor environments, using simulation states and episode records to independently verify outcomes and task requirements; humans reach 84% strict success while seven frontier VLMs show two complementary failure modes.
summary.zh: ROAM-Bench 在机器人运动与碰撞约束下评测具身主动空间智能，含 5 组 11 类共 250 个任务、27 个室内环境，用仿真状态和 episode 记录独立核验结果与任务要求；人类严格成功率达 84%，七个前沿 VLM 暴露出两类互补失败模式。

summary.en: PyRUA-Dex lets coding agents build programmatic dexterous bimanual policies without demonstrations, distilling parallel exploration into a task library and program, then refining with randomized layouts; it scores 72.9 SOTA on Bench2Dex and 81.0% on DexJoCo.
summary.zh: PyRUA-Dex 让编码智能体无需高质量示教即可为双手灵巧操作编写程序化策略：先并行探索技能与组合方式，再由蒸馏智能体压缩成任务库和一段程序，最后用随机布局提升鲁棒性与效率；在 Bench2Dex 上取得 72.9 的 SOTA 分数，DexJoCo 完全随机化下成功率 81.0%，真机 22 自由度双手平台学一首钢琴曲最快约 30 分钟。

summary.en: Distilling long-horizon policies from teacher actions alone with empty reasoning blocks enables cross-format transfer, boosting Qwen3-4B on AppWorld from 7% to 18%, and to 48% with CoT-proxies and GPT-5.6 Luna outputs.
summary.zh: 仅用教师模型动作轨迹蒸馏长程策略，学生推理块留空并加KL回放约束，跨格式迁移使Qwen3-4B在AppWorld上从7%升至18%，加CoT-proxies可达35%；蒸馏GPT-5.6 Luna的可见输出使Qwen3-4B升至48%，SWE-bench Verified升至28%。

orgs.name: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

summary.en: OmniAct conditions a flow-matching policy on per-robot kinematic graphs linking joints, motion axes and vision, trained on one million procedural embodiments; it reaches 63.0% success versus 17.8% for pi 0.5 and roughly doubles MolmoAct2 on an unseen real robot.
summary.zh: OmniAct 用运动学图将机器人关节位置、运动轴与视觉观测关联，以 flow-matching 策略预测各节点相对关节运动；在 100 万个程序化生成的可行机体上训练后，100 万机体规模下的留出评估成功率达 63.0%，远超 pi 0.5 的 17.8% 和最强基线 57.9%，在未见真实机器人上成功率约为次优方法 MolmoAct2 的两倍。

summary.en: FOCI, a trajectory optimization algorithm using Gaussian overlap integrals for collision-free planning directly on 3D Gaussian Splats across various robot morphologies.
summary.zh: FOCI的轨迹优化算法，利用3D高斯喷洒的重叠积分为多形态机器人直接在3DGS环境中规划无碰撞轨迹，实现了面向朝向的窄空间通行，并在几秒钟内完成计算。

summary.en: RoboARC, a benchmark of 90 spatial constraint manipulation tasks in MuJoCo. Evaluating seven coding agents and four VLA policies, the best agent solves 86% in privileged mode and 43% in standard mode, while zero-shot VLAs fail all.
summary.zh: 推出了RoboARC基准测试，包含MuJoCo中的90个空间约束操作任务，评估了七个编程智能体和四个VLA策略。最强的GPT-6 Astra在特权模式下解决了86%的任务，在标准模式下解决了43%的任务，而四个零样本VLA策略均未通过单臂谜题。

summary.en: Best-of-N test-time steering in VLA models can lead to reward hacking when the verifier is inaccurate, though calibration and softmax selection can mitigate this issue.
summary.zh: 针对视觉语言动作模型在部署时采用的Best-of-N测试时引导策略，研究发现当验证器不准确时增加N会导致奖励攻击并降低性能；该实验在60个LIBERO-Safety任务中使用pi_{0.5}策略进行评估，并表明校准验证器和softmax选择可以缓解该问题。

orgs.name: University of Science and Technology of China

summary.en: Play2Evolve uses playfulness as feedback in a recursive initialize-refine-evolve framework where agents playtest games, diagnose functionality, visuals and gameplay, and pair video generation with code; it scores 60.05 on GameCraft-Bench versus 50.81 and 52.46, with human ratings of 3.67.
summary.zh: Play2Evolve 以可玩性为反馈，用三段式递归框架（初始化、精炼、进化）让智能体试玩诊断功能、视觉与玩法问题，并结合视频生成模型产出素材，在 GameCraft-Bench 上得 60.05，高于 Game Initialization 的 50.81 和 Play2Code 的 52.46，人工整体质量评分 3.67。

summary.en: We present a 3D simulation pipeline for passive SPAD imaging that generates realistic photon detections and semantic labels, enabling high-accuracy zero-shot sim-to-real transfer for low-light perception tasks under sub-2 lux illumination.
summary.zh: 开发了一个3D模拟流水线用于生成逼真的单光子雪崩二极管（SPAD）图像及语义标签，通过耦合场景几何与光子噪声模型，实现了在低于2勒克斯的极低光照环境下无需真实数据微调的零样本迁移，在分类、旋转估计和语义分割任务中均表现出高准确率。

summary.en: Skeptic grounds repair in measured action outcomes and admits skills by measured task success via a depth-and-proprioception event log; false-impossibility tasks drop from 19.5 to 8.5, and held-out success rises 14.9 and 11.7 points on LIBERO-Pro and Robosuite.
summary.zh: Skeptic 用实测动作效果引导修复、以实测任务成功准入技能，并用带深度与本体感知的事件日志区分观测与诊断；在 60 个审计任务上，误判物理不可行的任务数从 19.5 降至 8.5，LIBERO-Pro 与 Robosuite 留出成功率分别提升 14.9 和 11.7 个百分点。

summary.en: DexEngine is a simulation pipeline that retargets human hand-object demonstrations into physically executable arm-hand trajectories via reachability placement, arm fitting, and residual RL correction, producing 65,000 trajectories (116 h) across four dexterous hands and yielding policies that outperform uncorrected data baselines in simulation and on a real robot.
summary.zh: DexEngine 用仿真流水线把人类手物操作数据转成整臂-手可执行轨迹：先定位到可达位置、拟合手臂运动，再用残差强化学习在物理仿真中校正。从九个数据集为四种灵巧手各生成约 5,200 条片段，扩充为 65,000 条轨迹（116 小时）和 325,000 个 episode（578 小时），物体跟踪精度优于浮动手方法且比 RL 方法快 10 倍以上，训练的策略在仿真与真机上均优于未做物理校正的数据。

summary.en: FreshVLA is a VLA framework utilizing frequency-guided latent actions for hierarchical robot control, achieving 98.2% success on LIBERO and a 7.5% improvement over π_{0.5} in real-world experiments.
summary.zh: FreshVLA是一种基于频率引导与动态敏感学习范式的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，通过时序分层连续潜空间动作提升长周期行为能力。在LIBERO和LIBERO-Long上分别达到98.2%和98.0%的平均成功率，在CALVIN上达到4.52的平均序列长度，真实世界实验较π_{0.5}平均成功率提升7.5%。

summary.en: HiGLR analyzes spatial redundancy in self-attention and ConvFFNs, replacing finest-scale attention with a learned input-independent kernel and adding Block-Routed Hybrid Attention and a Dual-Space FFN, reaching state-of-the-art all-in-one image restoration with up to 4.24x inference speedup.
summary.zh: HiGLR 通过分析自注意力与 ConvFFN 的空间冗余，用输入无关核替换最细尺度注意力、提出 Block-Routed Hybrid Attention 与 Dual-Space FFN，在 all-in-one 图像复原上取得 SOTA，推理速度最高提升 4.24 倍。

summary.en: M^2-WAM introduces hierarchical visual and interaction memories for world-action models, achieving bounded memory footprints and outperforming Fast-WAM by over 50% on long-horizon benchmarks.
summary.zh: M^2-WAM是一种具备分层视觉与交互记忆的世界-动作模型，通过门控增量更新和跨模态分层检索机制，在保持恒定在线内存开销的同时支持长周期操作。在MIKASA-Robo和RMBench仿真基准上，其平均成功率较Fast-WAM分别绝对提升了53.2%和61.2%。

summary.en: FLUENT trains looped models to use fewer computation steps through practice, improving real-robot success from 62.3% to 74.6% and reducing mean time from 69s to 31s.
summary.zh: FLUENT方法训练循环模型，通过蒸馏早期预测并利用冻结教师模型锚定最终预测，使模型在实践中学会使用更少计算步骤。在真实机器人实验中，成功率从62.3%提升至74.6%，成功任务的平均时间从69秒降至31秒。

summary.en: DuoWM integrates dual 6-DoF visual flows and transform-aware pretraining for drone video world modeling, outperforming Captain Safari in video quality, 3D consistency, and real-domain FVD by 17.2%.
summary.zh: DuoWM引入了动作流和物体流两种视觉条件，并通过变换感知预训练，在Sekai-drone数据集上取得了最佳的视频质量、3D一致性和轨迹跟随性能，相比Captain Safari在真实域的FVD和LPIPS分别降低了17.2%和21.6%。

summary.en: DriftWAM is an efficient distillation framework for world-action models that incorporates action-aware video drifting and action-guided regularization, outperforming prior consistency methods on RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO, and real-world tasks.
summary.zh: DriftWAM是一个用于机器人控制的高效world-action models蒸馏框架，通过引入动作感知的视频漂移和动作引导的视频正则化，在RoboTwin 2.0和LIBERO基准及真实世界任务中，以相同推理速度持续优于以往的一致性蒸馏方法。

summary.en: CompactWAM optimizes world action models via sparse dynamic representation learning and Dynamic Forcing, achieving 98.4% success on LIBERO while using only 9.2% of the dense future token budget.
summary.zh: CompactWAM通过稀疏动态表示学习优化世界动作模型，利用Dynamic Forcing结合直接动作监督与稠密未来引导，在LIBERO上实现了98.4%的成功率，且仅需9.2%的稠密未来Token预算。

summary.en: To mitigate directional bias caused by initial noise in VLAs, we propose a framework with training and inference interventions, increasing the success rate of $\pi_{0.5}$ from 40% to 68% in real-world experiments.
summary.zh: 针对视觉-语言-动作模型中初始噪声导致动作空间方向偏差的问题，提出了一种在训练和推理阶段进行干预的简单框架。该方法在训练时强制对偶噪声对产生一致的预测，并在推理时去除噪声的时间均值，在真实机器人实验中将$\pi_{0.5}$的平均任务成功率从40%提升至68%。

summary.en: CoTAMP combines LLMs and code modules for cooperative task and motion planning in quadruped robots, achieving a 100 percent success rate in 30 trials and outperforming baselines in feasibility and efficiency.
summary.zh: CoTAMP通过结合大语言模型和代码模块实现了四足机器人的协作式任务与动作规划，在30次模拟试验中全部生成了运动学有效的参考轨迹，并在成功率、动态可行性等方面优于多个基线。

summary.en: SEEK retains execution knowledge across attempts via a Self-Evolving Programmatic Policy and a Persistent Action-Effect Bank; on RoboDojo's 42 tasks ten attempts raise score from 27.0 to 54.4 and success from 19.7% to 48.0%, with 77.6% fewer GPT-6.2 Astra requests.
summary.zh: SEEK 是可跨尝试保留执行知识的机器人操作框架：Self-Evolving Programmatic Policy (SEPP) 将操作编码为可执行程序，并依据当前观测决定动作；Persistent Action-Effect Bank (PAEB) 记录动作实测效果，用于修订程序；在 RoboDojo 全部 42 项任务上，十次尝试将平均任务分从 27.0 提升至 54.4、成功率从 19.7% 提升至 48.0%，在 34 项任务上使用 GPT-6.2 Astra 五次尝试达到 80.1，而直接调用同一模型为 49.6，模型请求减少 77.6%。

summary.en: IMFPO achieves efficient one-step generative policy optimization for embodied control via decoupled velocity learning and drift-aware velocity alignment, reducing action-generation latency on Go2 from 15.57 ms to 0.41 ms compared to 64-step RFPO.
summary.zh: iMFPO通过解耦速度学习和漂移感知速度对齐，实现了具身控制的高效一步生成策略优化。在Go2、G1、H1和Spot上评估取得了显著回报，在Go2上动作生成延迟相比64步RFPO从15.57毫秒降至0.41毫秒。

summary.en: WorldReforge builds the 62k-trajectory Reforge dataset by perturbing reference grasps and adds Interaction Alignment and Surface Correspondence training signals, cutting Cosmos3 Nano's object-trajectory error by 35.0% on unseen objects and action-divergence error by 43.3%.
summary.zh: WorldReforge 用扰动参考抓取得到的 62k 条模拟轨迹构建 Reforge 数据集，并引入 Interaction Alignment 与 Surface Correspondence 两种训练信号，使 Cosmos3 Nano 在未见物体上的物体轨迹误差降低 35.0%，两动作结果差异预测误差降低 43.3%。

summary.en: HeadLight efficiently adapts specialized Next-Interaction and Motion heads in World-Action Models, achieving 62.28% success on RoboTwin tasks while updating only 1.1% of parameters, outperforming full fine-tuning and LoRA.
summary.zh: 引入HeadLight参数高效微调方法，针对性地联合适应World-Action Models中的Next-Interaction Heads和Motion Heads。在未见过的RoboTwin任务中，仅更新1.1%的参数即达到62.28%的成功率，优于全参数微调的57.89%和LoRA的58.66%。

summary.en: QK-Bench with 2,341 QA pairs to evaluate quantitative kinematic understanding in MLLMs, revealing that the strongest model achieves only 41.2% accuracy without consistent advantages from spatial MLLMs.
summary.zh: 针对多模态大语言模型提出了包含2,341个多项式问答对的QK-Bench，用于评估动态空间智能中的定量运动学理解能力。实验表明，当前最强模型的总体准确率仅为41.2%，现有空间大模型在此任务上并未表现出明显优势。

summary.en: Aegis-VLA is a world-model-guided VLA framework that refines actions using a trajectory world model and reliability gating, achieving a 56.72% success rate on the DOM benchmark.
summary.zh: Aegis-VLA是一个由世界模型引导的视觉-语言-动作框架，通过轨迹世界模型预测物体运动与不确定性，并利用可靠性门控机制动态修正动作。在模拟动态物体操作基准测试中，其成功率达到56.72%，比基线高出11.28个百分点。

summary.en: An end-to-end image-goal navigation policy for agile quadrotors directly commands thrust and angular rates without state estimation, achieving an 82.3% success rate in unseen environments and an 84% zero-shot success rate on a real drone.
summary.zh: 针对敏捷四旋翼无人机提出了一种端到端图像目标导航策略，通过四阶段训练流水线直接输出推力和角速度控制指令，无需状态估计器或SLAM。在未见过的环境中实现了82.3%的成功率，平均终端位置误差为0.10米，并在真实四旋翼上取得了84%的零样本成功率。

summary.en: Stable Gated DeltaNet-2 fixes GDN-2's exponential recurrent state growth via symmetric erasure and decay-regulated residual writing, with an O(√T) bound. On 1.6B models it raises 128K RULER by 6.80 and nine-task accuracy by 0.62.
summary.zh: 针对 Gated DeltaNet-2 长上下文训练中擦除方向不对称导致循环状态指数增长的问题，提出 Stable Gated DeltaNet-2，用对称擦除保证非扩张状态传播，并配合衰减调节的残差写入，理论上给出 O(√T) 状态增长上界且保留分块并行。1.6B 参数模型上训练稳定，128K 平均 RULER 分数提升 6.80 分，九个下游任务平均准确率提升 0.62 分。

summary.en: WorldBridge encodes scattered, low-overlap references into a global scene context with spatio-temporal reference attention and reprojection-guided latent consistency, enabling coherent controllable 3D world generation and outperforming state-of-the-art methods.
summary.zh: WorldBridge 将稀疏且几乎无重叠的参考图像编码为全局场景上下文，结合时空参考注意力与重投影引导的潜参考一致性优化，实现连贯可控的 3D 世界生成，并推出低重叠参考的基准套件，性能超越现有 SOTA。

summary.en: SimpleUAV is a training-free agent for aerial object search using a frozen VLM without persistent maps, achieving a 41.61% success rate on UAV-ON.
summary.zh: SimpleUAV利用冻结的视觉语言模型构建了一个免训练的极简空中物体搜索智能体，无需持久化空间地图。它在UAV-ON数据集上取得了41.61%的成功率，显著超越以往基线模型。

summary.en: CoTacWAM jointly models vision and touch semantics for robotic manipulation, outperforming baselines and ensuring robustness to missing inputs across four real-world tasks.
summary.zh: CoTacWAM通过联合建模手腕视觉与触觉的共享接触语义，实现了卓越的机器人操作性能，在四项真实世界任务中超越了对比基线，并展现出对缺失局部观测的鲁棒性及自主重试的增益效果。

summary.en: WAtcher is a safety-aware world-action framework that imagines future outcomes and evaluates risks to prevent hazardous actions, reducing risky closed-loop trials from 27.0% to 10.8% while maintaining success rates.
summary.zh: WAtcher是一个具身安全意识的世界动作框架，利用两步去噪的高效世界动作模型和一个轻量级安全防护模块来想象未来并评估风险。该方法将训练任务中的危险闭环试验从27.0%降至10.8%，在保持任务成功率的同时显著提升了安全性。

summary.en: FoundSurface combines pointmap and ray representations to reconstruct continuous, high-fidelity 3D surfaces from unposed images, using a pointmap prior, cross-attention coarse regression, and raylet refinement, outperforming baselines in zero-shot generalization on 6 unseen datasets.
summary.zh: FoundSurface 将 pointmap 与 ray 表示结合，从无位姿图像直接重建连续高保真三维表面：先用 pointmap 模型提取几何先验，再经查询视角选择与 cross-attention 回归粗表面，最后用 raylet 模块恢复高频细节与解析法线，在 6 个未见数据集上零样本泛化优于现有方法。

summary.en: WorldPhy is introduced to benchmark fine-grained physical plausibility for robotics world models, featuring 300 tasks, 12K+ human annotations, WorldPhyReward, and evaluations of 13 frontier models revealing current limitations.
summary.zh: WorldPhy基准用于评估机器人世界模型的细粒度物理合理性，包含300个任务和超12K条人类标注，训练了WorldPhyReward模型，并对13个前沿世界模型进行了系统评估，发现现有模型在保持物理合理性方面仍存在不足。

summary.en: In NVIDIA's NOOA harness, models decide via a context API when and what to compact; GPT 6.1 nearly tripled OfficeQA Pro v2 accuracy at 32K budget (21%→56%), Kimi used up to 41% fewer input tokens, and reusing KV cache cut prefill compute up to 15%.
summary.zh: 在 NVIDIA 开源 agent harness NOOA 中让模型通过 context API 自主决定何时压缩上下文，在 8K–512K 预算的文档研究与 ML 工程任务上与 harness 驱动的压缩对比：GPT 6.1 在 32K 预算下 OfficeQA Pro v2 准确率由 21% 升至 56%，Kimi 输入 token 最多减少 41%；复用 KV cache 的未变后缀可将 prefill 计算降低最多 15% 且精度无损。

summary.en: OS-Omni is a live cross-platform benchmark for computer-using agents spanning Windows, Ubuntu, macOS, iOS, Android, and Web; its v1 has 48 tasks per platform plus 12 cross-platform workflows averaging 67.54 steps. Claude Opus 5.5 scores 68.5% versus 77.3% human, trailing by over 25 points on iOS and macOS.
summary.zh: OS-Omni 是覆盖 Windows、Ubuntu、macOS、iOS、Android 和 Web 的跨平台计算机代理实时基准，v1 每平台 48 个任务、另含 12 个跨平台工作流，任务平均需 67.54 步；最强代理 Claude Opus 5.5 平均成功率 68.5%，低于人类 77.3%，在 iOS 和 macOS 上差距超过 25 点。

summary.en: VibeVideoAgent is a training-free framework letting coding agents inspect drafts via short-lived multimodal perception and seven primitives over a unified multi-clock representation; on 239 VibeVideoBench tasks it lifts Claude Opus 5.5's L3 from 4.03 to 4.43, with audio-visual sync gains up to +0.56.
summary.zh: VibeVideoAgent 是一个免训练框架，让编程智能体在生成过程中通过短时上下文的多模态感知检查草稿，并借助统一多时钟表示上的七种原语返回精简的 Findings 反馈；在 239 个 VibeVideoBench 任务上，Claude Opus 5.5 的整体视听质量 L3 由 4.03 升至 4.43，音画同步最多提升 0.56。

summary.en: A LiDAR-based autonomous exploration system on a Unitree Go2 Wheeled quadruped successfully completed a 370m vineyard traversal, demonstrating robust row-following capabilities in field tests.
summary.zh: 基于Unitree Go2 Wheeled四足机器人开发了一套LiDAR自主探索系统，结合迭代RANSAC直线检测与有限状态导航策略。在英国Denbies葡萄园的实地评估中，系统成功完成了不间断的370米往返自主行间穿行，验证了其在复杂农业环境中的可行性。

summary.en: CamAct improves robotic manipulation by incorporating camera motion supervision from in-the-wild videos alongside robot demonstrations, raising success rates on LIBERO from 96.40% to 98.10% and on RoboCasa 365 from 22.96% to 29.32%.
summary.zh: CamAct通过引入野外视频中恢复的相机运动监督来辅助机器人操作策略，将其与机器人示范数据结合，在LIBERO上的成功率从96.40%提升至98.10%，在RoboCasa 365上从22.96%提升至29.32%。

summary.en: RehearsalWorld decouples physical priors from video generation using 3D Interaction Rehearsal, reducing gripper-relative offset by 79% to 84% on real DROID sequences while achieving a 23.92 dB PSNR and 149 FVD.
summary.zh: RehearsalWorld通过3D交互预演将物理约束与视频生成解耦，利用预训练3D点流模型预测轨迹并经几何投影引导视频生成器，在真实DROID抓取数据集上将夹爪相对偏移降低了约79%至84%，达到23.92 dB的PSNR和149的FVD。

summary.en: StateWeaver converts review-detected state discrepancies into concrete visual asset requirements and isolates task contexts via hierarchical collaboration and memory, outperforming existing methods on multiple benchmarks for cross-shot consistent long video generation.
summary.zh: StateWeaver 用 Active States 把审阅发现的状态偏差转成具体视觉资产需求，配合分层协作与分层记忆隔离任务上下文，在多基准上超越现有方法，实现长视频跨镜头一致性。

summary.en: AIRIS is a causal streaming benchmark that decomposes social embodied intelligence into a time-anchored Attention-Intention-Reaction-Interaction chain, with 8,000 questions over 357 egocentric clips where models see only the observation prefix; evaluating 45 models reveals fragmented, temporally miscalibrated competence.
summary.zh: AIRIS 是一个因果流式基准，将社交具身智能拆解为 Attention、Intention、Reaction、Interaction 的时间锚定链条，基于 357 段第一视角视频构建 8,000 道题，模型只能看到查询时刻之前的观察前缀；评测 45 个专有与开源模型后发现能力碎片化且时间校准失准。

summary.en: TL-VLA replaces natural-language instructions with temporal logic for vision-language-action models, achieving 3.800 average chain length and 62.3% five-task success on CALVIN ABC->D.
summary.zh: TL-VLA通过引入时序逻辑替代自然语言指令，结合图编码器与视觉逻辑融合模块，实现具备长视距规划能力的具身智能控制。在CALVIN ABC->D任务中平均链长达到3.800且五任务成功率达62.3%，优于基线模型。

summary.en: This review surveys embodied lower-limb exoskeletons across four dimensions—structural, task, user adaptation, and control self-regulation—highlighting key challenges and future directions.
summary.zh: 这篇综述从具身视角系统梳理了下肢外骨骼技术，将其划分为结构自适应、任务自适应、用户特定自适应和控制自我调节四个维度，探讨了轻量化设计、数据融合与策略优化等核心挑战，并指出了未来发展方向。

summary.en: DocSEAM inserts a lightweight module between the vision encoder and LLM, fusing neighboring pages via center-anchored masked attention; the 9B model achieves SOTA on five multi-page document VQA benchmarks among open-weight models up to 10B and reduces sensitivity to page boundaries.
summary.zh: DocSEAM 在视觉编码器与语言模型间插入轻量模块，用局部三联页与中心锚定掩码注意力融合邻页信息，9B 模型在五个多页文档 VQA 基准上取得不超过 10B 参数开放权重模型中的 SOTA，并降低对分页边界的敏感度。

summary.en: Evaluating vision foundation models on force awareness reveals they capture contact timing but fail to quantify applied interaction force, highlighting a key capability gap.
summary.zh: 通过在两个操作数据集上训练轻量级读取头，评估了冻结的视觉基础模型、世界模型和策略模型表示对接触力的感知能力。实验表明，大多数模型能捕捉接触发生的时机，但无法捕捉施加的具体力大小，且机器人后训练也无法改善这一问题。

summary.en: HoloBrain-0.5 is a family of VLA models for cross-embodiment manipulation. The post-trained continuous policy outperforms pi_0.5 on a seven-task benchmark (94.52% vs. 86.25%) and an 11-task dual-arm benchmark (79.07% vs. 69.41%).
summary.zh: HoloBrain-0.5 是一系列跨具身的视觉-语言-动作模型，通过统一的 3D 运动学表示在共享动作空间中规划。在六个仿真任务中离散策略取得了更高的平均成功率（56.77% 对 49.71%），而后训练的连续策略在七个真实任务 benchmark 上超越了 $\pi_{0.5}$（94.52% 对 86.25%）。

summary.en: ProxyGenBench benchmarks five video generators on 312 cases with verified checklists, testing structure preservation, content completion, and multimodal condition binding; strong structural adherence does not ensure correct binding.
summary.zh: ProxyGenBench 用 312 个评测案例、60 个场景和验证过的案例检查表，评估五种视频生成器在保持结构、补全缺失内容并绑定文本、图像、音频条件方面的表现，发现结构遵循强不代表条件绑定正确。

summary.en: EgoUseBench builds 693 tasks from 74+ hours of real first-person recordings to evaluate computer-use agents across three settings; Online Ego Use success rates are 26.3% lower than Computer-Use.
summary.zh: EgoUseBench 基于超过 74 小时的真实第一人称录像构建 693 个任务，在 Computer-Use、Offline Ego Use 和 Online Ego Use 三种设定下评测计算机使用智能体，并发现 Online Ego Use 的平均成功率比 Computer-Use 低 26.3%。

summary.en: Graph Anchors improves long-horizon planning in latent world models by replacing distant goals with intermediate graph nodes, raising success rates from low single digits to over 70% across multiple tasks.
summary.zh: Graph Anchors通过在潜在世界模型的训练帧上构建稀疏图，将长视距规划转化为一系列短视距导航，从而解决了潜在世界模型在远距离和接触阶段的规划失效问题。在多个任务中，该方法将LeWM的成功率从5%-13%大幅提升至71%-87%。

summary.en: AGLR is a unified framework for fine-grained humanoid motion generation and editing via attribute-guided latent refinement, achieving high success rates and fast editing speeds without test-time optimization.
summary.zh: AGLR是一个用于人形机器人运动生成和编辑的统一框架，通过属性引导的潜在空间精炼，支持对肢体范围、躯干方向和根轨迹的可组合时变控制。在HumanML3D-G1数据集上，该方法取得了最高的可控生成和保持约束编辑成功率，500帧运动的编辑仅需9.1毫秒。

summary.en: M2AdaptVLA integrates visual and wrench memories with predictive test-time adaptation, achieving an 82.71% mean success rate across eight challenging robotic tasks, yielding a 31.46% absolute gain over the strongest baseline.
summary.zh: M2AdaptVLA结合了视觉与力觉记忆以及预测性测试时自适应，通过视觉测试时训练、力觉上下文门控和辅助力觉预测损失，在八项需视觉与力觉记忆的任务中取得了82.71%的平均成功率，比最强基线绝对提升了31.46%。

summary.en: RIPPLE integrates ElasticMembrane and MJLab for sim-to-real humanoid control on elastic terrains, achieving at least 98.7% standing success in simulation and zero-shot deployment on a MagicBot Z1 robot.
summary.zh: RIPPLE框架，通过结合ElasticMembrane模型和MJLab实现人形机器人在大变形弹性地形上的强化学习与Sim-to-Real迁移。实验表明，该方法在仿真中实现了至少98.7%的站立成功率，并成功零样本部署于MagicBot Z1机器人完成平衡与连续跳跃。

summary.en: Sage-Med-Preview, a 35B-parameter (3B activated) medical MLLM trained via curated 322.7M-record data and a progressive pretraining-to-SFT-to-RL curriculum, scores 58.26% on 31 public multimodal benchmarks, beating Hulu-Med-235B-A22B (50.99%) and Intern-S2-Preview (52.24%).
summary.zh: Sage-Med-Preview 是 35B 参数（激活 3B）的医学多模态模型，用 3.227 亿条候选数据分阶段筛选结合医学预训练、分阶段监督微调与自适应强化学习的渐进课程训练，在 31 个公开多模态基准上均分 58.26%，超过 Hulu-Med-235B-A22B 的 50.99% 和 Intern-S2-Preview 的 52.24%。

summary.en: ΜMPC is a fast MPC framework using learned Koopman-linearized dynamics for microsecond-scale control, achieving up to 108x faster constrained MPC and 1907x faster visuomotor planning than competing methods.
summary.zh: μMPC是一个通过学习Koopman线性化动态实现微秒级非线性与世界模型控制的框架，利用预计算的控制到输出映射消除了提升状态轨迹。该方法在桌面CPU上实现了低至23μs的求解时间，并在多个基准测试中比对比方法快高达108倍的约束MPC和1907倍的视触觉规划。

summary.en: MotionRep jointly predicts future DINO representations and 3D object flow using a diffusion transformer, outperforming pixel-based baselines in 3D accuracy and generalization with only three denoising steps.
summary.zh: MotionRep结合了DINO表示与3D物体流来联合预测未来状态，利用DINO-VAE进行高维特征压缩并通过扩散Transformer实现条件生成。实验表明，该方法在3D物体流精度和未见场景泛化能力上优于基于像素的基线，推理仅需三步去噪。

summary.en: Nav4Manip is a bidirectionally coupled co-evolution system for long-horizon dexterous mobile manipulation, integrating navigation and manipulation feedback to achieve state-of-the-art performance on benchmarks and real-world tasks.
summary.zh: Nav4Manip是一个双向耦合的共进系统，用于长视野灵巧移动操作。它通过Nav4Manip-N学习导航并利用操作反馈进行优化，同时通过Nav4Manip-M训练世界动作模型（WAM）处理下游操作，在公共VLN和Nav-N-Manip基准测试中展现出最先进的性能。

summary.en: DemoFoundry uses coding agents and generative rendering to synthesize photorealistic and physically grounded robot demonstrations, achieving policy performance close to training on real data.
summary.zh: DemoFoundry利用编程智能体与生成式渲染技术合成了具备真实视觉与物理基础的机器人示范数据，通过构建对齐的真实-代理视频对并结合物理仿真执行程序生成数据，在策略训练中接近了等量真实示范的性能。

summary.en: RoboEvo$^2$ recursively co-evolves a coding harness and VLA policy via policy-to-harness search and harness-to-policy distillation, raising LIBERO-PRO success from 11.0% to 84.1% and hybrid success from 30.4% to 90.5%.
summary.zh: RoboEvo$^2$ 通过由 policy 到 harness 的编码搜索与由 harness 到 policy 的监督训练及反事实偏好蒸馏实现递归协同进化，在 LIBERO-PRO 上将独立成功率从 11.0% 提至 84.1%，混合成功率从 30.4% 提至 90.5%，Unitree G1-D 上混合成功率达 95.0%。

summary.en: ShowNow, a fine-grained speculative streaming framework, precomputes 1–8 action-conditioned futures during playback. With single-latent commitment and shared-history tree execution, a 5B model reaches 480p at 16 fps on H100 and cuts ViZDoom median input-to-display latency from 620 to 208 ms.
summary.zh: ShowNow 细粒度投机流式框架利用播放期间算力预生成 1–8 个动作条件未来帧，配合单潜变量提交与共享历史树执行；5B 模型在 H100 上达 480p/16fps，ViZDoom 中将输入到显示中位延迟从 620ms 降至 208ms。

summary.en: We introduce ActRosetta to audit and repair action interface mismatches in navigation world models, reducing visual prediction error by 42% on RECON without retraining.
summary.zh: 针对导航世界模型中训练与部署阶段动作接口不匹配的问题，提出ActRosetta工具来审核并修复动作编码。在RECON数据集上无需重新训练即可将视觉预测误差降低42%，凸显了验证动作编码一致性的重要性。

summary.en: ELMO is an end-to-end imitation learning framework that jointly trains a VLA planner and decoder via dynamic hierarchical action chunking, outperforming prior methods by 9.6 percentage points on LIBERO-Plus.
summary.zh: ELMO是一个端到端模仿学习框架，通过动态分层动作分块联合训练VLA规划器与观测条件解码器，学习环境基础语义动作空间。在LIBERO-Plus上比同类方法提升9.6个百分点，在CALVIN平均任务长度上提升0.75。

summary.en: SOLVE is a training-free VLM agent policy that uses sparse ordered keyposes instead of dense control. It achieves 74.5% on RoboDojo and 84.5% on RoboLab at 12x lower cost, with an 88% success rate on real-world zero-shot tasks.
summary.zh: SOLVE是一种免训练的多模态大语言模型智能体策略，通过生成稀疏有序的6自由度末端关键位姿来替代密集控制，结合运动规划实现高效操作。它在RoboDojo和RoboLab上分别取得了74.5%和84.5%的最先进性能，成本比以往密集控制策略降低12倍，真实机器人零样本任务成功率达到88%。

summary.en: X-Harness pairs VLM reasoning with VLA/WAM control via a policy harness; 470K+ rollouts across 8 benchmarks reveal harness design rules, lifting base policies up to +42.8 points on memory, reasoning, and domain shifts without weight updates.
summary.zh: X-Harness 通过策略框架把 VLM 推理与 VLA/WAM 精确控制结合，基于 47 万余次 rollout、8 个仿真基准、6 个 VLM 和 15 个 VLA/WAM 检查点的七项受控实验，揭示框架需适配双方能力，在记忆、推理与域偏移任务上无需权重更新即提升基线最高 42.8 个点。

summary.en: HOG-WAM adds future HOG structural supervision to FastWAM via a training-only HOG DiT with asymmetric attention; mixed-noise success rises from 78.86% to 82.86% on RoboTwin-Plus and sensor-noise success from 74.14% to 78.89% on LIBERO Plus.
summary.zh: HOG-WAM 在 FastWAM 的 RGB-to-action 架构上加入未来 HOG 结构监督，训练时用 HOG DiT 通过非对称注意力读取 RGB 特征、推理时移除该模块；在 RoboTwin-Plus 混合噪声下成功率从 78.86% 提升到 82.86%，LIBERO Plus 传感器噪声下从 74.14% 提升到 78.89%，四个 Franka 任务的干净与含噪平均成功率分别从 40% 升到 59%、从 17% 升到 24%。

summary.en: On VBVR-Pro-Bench, coding agents (Codex/gpt-6-astra, Claude Code/Fable 5.1, Gemini CLI/Gemini 3.1 Pro) render answer videos via programs, scoring 0.923/0.894/0.893, each >0.22 above the best video model; best open-weight GLM-5 reaches 0.572.
summary.zh: 在VBVR-Pro-Bench上，Codex(gpt-6-astra)、Claude Code(Fable 5.1)与Gemini CLI(Gemini 3.1 Pro)等编程agent通过编写程序渲染答案视频，得分0.923/0.894/0.893，分别比最强视频生成模型高0.22以上；开源模型最优GLM-5仅0.572。

summary.en: Matched non-revisit controls show parameter revisit in looped MoE buys almost nothing; gains come from network shape and residual scale (a lower learning rate on revisited layers under AdamW). LoopTitan-Base, a non-revisit baseline under Muon, matches the strongest looped recipe, with 17 pretrained models released.
summary.zh: 用匹配预算的非重访对照组拆解 looped MoE，发现参数重访本身几乎没有收益，增益主要来自网络形状与残差缩放（相当于对重访层降低学习率），在 Muon 下残差缩放收益消失；据此提出无重访的 LoopTitan-Base，在 Muon 下匹配最强循环方案，并开源 17 个预训练模型。

summary.en: Real2SimLab is a unified platform that evaluates real-to-simulation methods by running their generated programs and scoring outputs with each benchmark's own scorer, covering 47 coding agents and 5 non-agent methods on 6 benchmarks, plus a contamination-filtered data and reward pipeline.
summary.zh: Real2SimLab 统一评测平台通过运行各方法生成的仿真程序，并调用各基准自带的评分器打分，避免了 N 种方法在 M 个基准上的 N×M 次集成；它支持 6 个基准上 47 个编程 agent 和 5 种非 agent 方法，还提供训练数据与奖励标注流水线，并通过过滤基准已有视频避免数据污染。

summary.en: DRBench Pro evaluates deep research agents by structured knowledge coverage, building knowledge trees from Wikipedia to generate queries and evidence-grounded rubrics across 144 cases and 44,102 rubrics; the best of 16 agents reaches only 57.04% coverage.
summary.zh: DRBench Pro 以结构化知识覆盖为核心评测目标，从 Wikipedia 构建本地知识树并采样子图生成研究查询与有证据支撑的评分细则，覆盖 24 个领域共 144 个案例、44,102 条细则，16 个深度研究 agent 中最佳整体覆盖率仅 57.04%。

summary.en: We introduce BOP-Refer, a benchmark for monocular 3D and 2D object grounding. Evaluating 17 frontier VLMs shows Gemini 4 Carbon achieves 72.6% AP_IoU2D in 2D but only 12.4% AP_IoU3D in 3D, revealing scale estimation as the primary error source.
summary.zh: 推出了首个针对日常与工业物体的单目3D和2D视觉定位基准BOP-Refer，通过对17个前沿VLM的系统评估发现，表现最好的Gemini 4 Carbon在2D中达到72.6%的AP_IoU2D，但在3D中仅有12.4%的AP_IoU3D，表明缺乏可靠物体尺寸先验的度量尺度估计是当前误差的主要来源。

summary.en: FineDex bridges fine-grained human-object interaction generation and dexterous humanoid manipulation by learning actionable priors and adapting at test time in a physics-based digital twin, achieving state-of-the-art results on real hardware.
summary.zh: FineDex是一个将细粒度人机交互生成与灵巧人形操作相结合的框架，利用生成的交互作为可行先验，在物理数字孪生中发现物理可行的接触策略，实现了最先进的HOI生成质量和灵巧操作成功率，并成功部署在真实灵巧人形机器人上。

summary.en: Agentic LongLive keeps entity memory on separate GPUs and prefills it into the generator's attention sink, raising LongLive-2.0 persistent-state accuracy by 26.3 points with about 1% extra generation time.
summary.zh: Agentic LongLive 用独立 GPU 上的记忆 agent 以文本状态和实体图像维护人物、物体、场景一致性，并通过辅助 GPU 预填充注意力 sink，使 LongLive-2.0 在 LongStory-Online 上持久状态准确率提升 26.3 点、主角身份提升 44.9 点、重访地点一致性提升 40.4 点，额外耗时约 1%。

summary.en: Cairn steers frozen VLAs along learned 3D object trajectories at test time, raising the success rate of a frozen pi0.5 model from 24.5% to 95.1% across LIBERO scenes with displaced objects and obstacles.
summary.zh: Cairn通过在测试时引导冻结的VLA沿学习到的3D轨迹运动，解决了VLA在面对新布局或障碍物时导航失效的问题。在LIBERO测试中，该方法将冻结的π0.5模型的成功率从24.5%提升至95.1%，并在真实Franka机器人实验中成功避开障碍物。

summary.en: We propose a dependence-aware, reversible memory-update mechanism to revise navigation authority under unreliable VLM evidence, preventing robots from relying on stale memories and outperforming baseline methods in real-world experiments.
summary.zh: 针对持久语义导航中VLM感知证据不可靠的问题，提出了一种依赖感知且可逆的记忆更新机制，能够避免重复计算相关未命中并动态修正记忆的可操作性。在真实机器人实验中，该方法成功避免了将陈旧记忆选为导航目标，表现优于基线方法。

summary.en: Mixture-of-Loops Transformer reuses keys and values as memory across depths and loops; U-MoLT beats OLMo3 with 1.7x CE token efficiency at 700M and +2.1 points on 10-task accuracy at 3B MoE.
summary.zh: Mixture-of-Loops Transformer 用 Mixture-of-Loops Attention 把 KV 当作跨深度和循环复用记忆，其 U-MoLT 变体在 400B token 预训练中于 700M 模型上比 OLMo3 达到 1.7 倍的验证交叉熵 token 效率，3B MoE 困惑度降低 0.75、10 项任务准确率提升 2.1 个百分点。

summary.en: PixelMatte adapts pretrained pixel-space diffusion transformers to high-fidelity matting, jointly processing image, trimap, and noisy alpha via native patch embedding and predicting alpha in one pass; LayerShift and High-Pass Refiner further refine results, cutting SAD and gradient errors by 24-44% versus RenderMatte on P3M-500-NP and AM-2K.
summary.zh: PixelMatte 把预训练的像素空间扩散 Transformer 用于高保真抠图，复用原生 patch embedding 将图像、trimap 和噪声 alpha 作为空间对齐 token 联合处理，单次前向即可预测 alpha，并用 LayerShift 与 High-Pass Refiner 提升区域不透明度与边界精度；在 P3M-500-NP 与 AM-2K 上相比 RenderMatte 降低 SAD 与梯度误差 24-44%。

summary.en: MERLoc uses a pose-based retrieval strategy over 3D Gaussian Splatting references for robust robot localization in dynamic environments, reducing position RMSE by 15-60% on real data while running onboard at 5 Hz.
summary.zh: MERLoc将单次3D Gaussian Splatting扫描转化为致密的功能参考内存，通过基于位姿的检索策略而非外观选择参考视图，在动态环境中实现了更稳健的机器人定位。在真实数据测试中，它在九分之十的后端组合中将位置RMSE降低了15-60%，并能在Jetson Orin NX上以5 Hz的频率板载运行。

summary.en: DexLink synthesizes diverse dexterous manipulation policies from sparse interaction templates combined with residual reinforcement learning, achieving performance comparable to dense tracking methods without requiring object-specific human demonstrations.
summary.zh: DexLink通过稀疏的可复用手物交互模板来合成多样化的灵巧操作行为。该方法利用优化将静态模板重定向至目标对象并连成参考轨迹，再通过残差强化学习在仿真中精炼为闭环策略，实验表明其无需特定物体的示范便可匹配密集参考追踪方法的效果，并具备零样本部署潜力。

summary.en: I2VT transfers image editing to video editors by having them role-play as image editors on single frames, guided per denoising step, achieving SOTA on OpenVE-Bench and the new OpenVE++.
summary.zh: I2VT 让视频编辑器在训练时以单帧图像扮演图像编辑器，由图像编辑器逐去噪步引导预测，无需配对视频即可把图像编辑能力迁移并扩展到动作、表情、肢体运动和场景重打光等任务，在 OpenVE-Bench 与 OpenVE++ 上取得 SOTA。

summary.en: AnyCam represents the camera via a reconstructed anchor object rendered along the target trajectory, then transfers source video content and dynamics with a video diffusion model; its H-Concat layout enables a streaming few-step generator and outperforms camera-controlled video generation and 3D reconstruction baselines.
summary.zh: AnyCam 以场景中的锚定物体来表示相机：先重建该物体的 3D 模型并沿目标轨迹渲染，得到尺度明确、视角完整且易于指定的相机信号，再用视频扩散模型将源视频的内容与动态迁移到新视角；H-Concat 布局对齐源帧与目标帧的时间，模型可蒸馏为流式少步生成器 AnyCam-AR。在多数据集与轨迹上，相机控制与视觉质量优于相机控制视频生成和 3D 重建方法。
